title: Back to the Future: Regressing Readability Features from LLMs
title_zh: 回到未来：从大型语言模型中回归可读性特征

paragraphs.en: Code readability determines how effectively and efficiently software can be understood, reviewed, and maintained. As AI coding agents assume a larger role in software engineering, readability gains a critical dual purpose: it allows human engineers to safely review agent-generated output, and it helps the agents themselves maintain code more effectively, as readable code tends to be more compact and less distracting within limited context windows. Yet, existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 代码的可读性决定了软件能否被有效且高效地理解、审查和维护。 随着 AI 编码智能体在软件工程中扮演更重要的角色，可读性获得了至关重要的双重作用：它使人类工程师能够安全地审查智能体生成的输出，同时也有助于智能体自身更有效地维护代码，因为可读性强的代码往往更紧凑，在有限的上下文窗口中也不易造成干扰。 然而，现有的可读性模型在不同数据集上并未始终与人类的判断保持一致。

sents.en: Code readability determines how effectively and efficiently software can be understood, reviewed, and maintained.
sents.zh: 代码的可读性决定了软件能否被有效且高效地理解、审查和维护。

sents.en: As AI coding agents assume a larger role in software engineering, readability gains a critical dual purpose: it allows human engineers to safely review agent-generated output, and it helps the agents themselves maintain code more effectively, as readable code tends to be more compact and less distracting within limited context windows.
sents.zh: 随着 AI 编码智能体在软件工程中扮演更重要的角色，可读性获得了至关重要的双重作用：它使人类工程师能够安全地审查智能体生成的输出，同时也有助于智能体自身更有效地维护代码，因为可读性强的代码往往更紧凑，在有限的上下文窗口中也不易造成干扰。

sents.en: Yet, existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets.
sents.zh: 然而，现有的可读性模型在不同数据集上并未始终与人类的判断保持一致。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we introduce BTTF ( B ack T o T he F uture), a model built on the principle of pairing an old-school linear regression backbone with new-school information-theoretic features. Rather than using large language models as opaque, black-box judges, BTTF leverages them as measurement instruments. BTTF combines traditional code measurements with embedding-based semantic organisation and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 BTTF（B ack T o T he F uture），该模型基于将传统线性回归主干模型与新型信息论特征相结合的原则构建。 BTTF 并未将大型语言模型用作不透明的黑箱评判者，而是将其作为测量工具加以利用。 BTTF 将传统的代码测量方法与基于嵌入的语义组织以及因果语言模型的预测能力相结合，以捕捉源代码的结构、语义连贯性和上下文中的意外性。

sents.en: To address this, we introduce BTTF ( B ack T o T he F uture), a model built on the principle of pairing an old-school linear regression backbone with new-school information-theoretic features.
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 BTTF（B ack T o T he F uture），该模型基于将传统线性回归主干模型与新型信息论特征相结合的原则构建。

sents.en: BTTF combines traditional code measurements with embedding-based semantic organisation and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise.
sents.zh: BTTF 将传统的代码测量方法与基于嵌入的语义组织以及因果语言模型的预测能力相结合，以捕捉源代码的结构、语义连贯性和上下文中的意外性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BTTF across the complete set of five publicly available human-rated code-readability benchmarks, supplemented by our manually annotated MBJP development set, for a total of 1,100 samples. Across this comprehensive suite, BTTF establishes a new state of the art, improving average Spearman correlation over the strongest baseline by up to 0.101. Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations applied to production code, it achieves response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. Its performance is the highest among local models and trails the strongest cloud-LLM response by 1.7% in Java and 5.1% in Python. The direct-LLM baselines require an average of 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation while remaining opaque. Unlike alternative methods, BTTF delivers state-of-the-art benchmark performance and strong transformation robustness alongside feature-granular interpretability, with every feature’s coefficient strictly matching its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在全部五个公开可用的人类评分代码可读性基准数据集上对 BTTF 进行了评估，并辅以我们手动标注的 MBJP 开发集，总计包含 1,100 个样本。 在这一套全面的测试中，BTTF 创造了新的行业最佳水平，其平均斯皮尔曼相关系数相较于最强的基线模型最高提升了 0.101。 在对生产代码应用 13 种受控的可读性降低转换后，BTTF 在 Java 中的响应率达到 93.8%，在 Python 中为 87.6%，分别比 Dorn 高出 14% 和 19.2%。 其性能在所有本地模型中最高，但在 Java 中比最强的云端大语言模型（LLM）的响应低 1.7%，在 Python 中低 5.1%。 直接调用 LLM 的基线方法每次评估平均需要 1,083 个提示词标记，且其决策过程仍然不透明。 与其他方法不同，BTTF 不仅实现了行业最佳的基准测试性能和强大的转换鲁棒性，还提供了细粒度特征可解释性：在所有评估的模型配置中，每个特征的系数都严格与其理论上的方向性效应一致。

paragraphs.en: Code readability is central to software engineering because source code is repeatedly read, reviewed, debugged, and modified throughout its lifetime. The need for reliable automated assessment has now become urgent as LLM-driven coding agents rapidly proliferate. As agents shift human engineers from primary authors into reviewers, high throughput makes human inspection the central bottleneck: a strain compounded by legal and regulatory mandates that require human auditing of deployed software for the foreseeable future, even if source code eventually becomes the “new assembly”. In this emerging paradigm, readability serves a critical dual purpose: it eases the burden on human reviewers evaluating agent-generated output, and it enables agents themselves to navigate and reason over codebases more effectively without cluttering context windows. Readability must therefore be measured explicitly, interpretably, and at scale to give developers actionable feedback, guide LLM post-training, and enable agents to optimise code for both human auditing and downstream maintenance. Despite many proposed measures and predictive models, aligning automated metrics with human judgement remains an open challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 代码的可读性在软件工程中至关重要，因为源代码在其整个生命周期中都会被反复阅读、审查、调试和修改。 随着由大型语言模型驱动的智能体迅速普及，对可靠自动化评估的需求现已变得迫在眉睫。 随着智能体将人类工程师从主要编写者转变为审查者，高吞吐量使得人工检查成为核心瓶颈：而法律与监管要求在未来可预见的时期内仍需对人类审计已部署的软件进行监督，这一压力将进一步加剧，即便源代码最终可能成为“新的汇编语言”。 在这种新兴范式下，可读性发挥着关键的双重作用：它既减轻了审查智能体生成结果的人类审查者的负担，也使智能体自身能够更有效地浏览和推理代码库，而无需让上下文窗口变得杂乱。 因此，必须对可读性进行明确、可解释且可扩展的衡量，以便为开发者提供可行的反馈，指导大型语言模型的后续训练，并帮助智能体优化代码，以满足人类审计和后续维护的双重需求。 尽管已有许多拟定的指标和预测模型，但如何将自动化指标与人类判断对齐，仍然是一个尚未解决的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Existing work follows three main directions. Feature-based machine-learning models use explicit lexical, structural, textual, and visual measurements ( Buse and Weimer, 2009 ; Posnett et al., 2011 ; Dorn, 2012 ; Scalabrino et al., 2018 ) . Smaller formulations rely on broad proxies, while larger feature inventories can combine language- or presentation-specific measurements whose fitted directions are difficult to interpret consistently. Deep-learning models instead learn representations directly from source code, but provide less visibility into the properties that determine a prediction ( Mi et al., 2018 ; Mi et al., 2022 ) . More recently, language models have been used to generate readability judgements or to measure whole-program prediction difficulty, although their reported agreement with human ratings remains variable ( Ouédraogo et al., 2025 ; Dillmann et al., 2024 ) . Across these directions, the two core challenges remain: generalisation and explainability.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究主要沿着三个方向展开。 基于特征的传统机器学习模型使用明确的词汇、结构、文本和视觉测量指标（Buse 和 Weimer，2009；Posnett 等，2011；Dorn，2012；Scalabrino 等，2018）。 规模较小的模型依赖宽泛的代理指标，而特征集较大的模型则可能结合语言或呈现方式特定的测量指标，但这些指标的拟合方向难以保持一致性地进行解释。 相比之下，深度学习模型直接从源代码中学习表示，但对其预测结果所依据的具体特性缺乏透明度（Mi 等，2018；Mi 等，2022）。 近期，语言模型被用于生成可读性判断或衡量整个程序的预测难度，尽管它们与人类评分的一致性仍存在较大差异（Ouédraogo 等，2025；Dillmann 等，2024）。 在这些不同方向中，两个核心挑战始终存在：泛化能力和可解释性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 makes the first challenge concrete. The example hides a month-offset lookup inside a string and character-code calculation. All five developers who rated the example assign it the minimum readability score of 1/5. Four established readability models nevertheless place it between the 74th and 92nd percentiles of their benchmark predictions. DS-V4-Pro and BTTF both recognise the code as difficult, but BTTF also identifies the specific source regions and measurements responsible for its low score.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 使第一个挑战具体化。 该示例将一个月偏移量的查找操作隐藏在字符串和字符编码计算之中。 所有五位对该示例进行评分的开发者都给出了最低的可读性分数 1/5。 尽管如此，四个成熟的可读性模型仍将其置于基准预测结果的第 74 至 92 百分位之间。 DS-V4-Pro 和 BTTF 都将该代码识别为困难，但 BTTF 还指出了导致其得分较低的具体来源区域和度量指标。

paragraphs.en: People do not understand complex material by retaining every detail independently. Related and recurring elements can instead be represented through shared patterns and higher-level abstractions. From an information-theoretic perspective, this is compression: many observations are encoded by a shorter internal description ( Chater and Vitányi, 2003 ; Feldman, 2016 ) . Program comprehension likewise produces mental representations at multiple levels of abstraction ( Pennington, 1987 ; Bidlake et al., 2020 ) . In source code, identifiers, expressions, assignments, and control structures may collectively express concepts such as input validation, state updates, or iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 人们并非通过独立记住每一个细节来理解复杂材料的。 相反，相关且重复出现的元素可以通过共享的模式和更高层级的抽象来表示。 从信息论的角度来看，这就是压缩：许多观察结果可以通过一个更简短的内部描述进行编码（Chater and Vitányi, 2003；Feldman, 2016）。 程序理解同样会在多个抽象层级上产生心理表征（Pennington, 1987；Bidlake et al., 2020）。 在源代码中，标识符、表达式、赋值语句和控制结构可以共同表达诸如输入验证、状态更新或迭代等概念。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we introduce BTTF ( B ack T o T he F uture), a readability model built on the principle of combining an old-school linear regression backbone with new-school information-theoretic features. Rather than treating large language models as opaque, end-to-end judges, BTTF uses pretrained causal LMs and continuous embedding spaces purely as measurement instruments. Linear regression provides transparency by ensuring that every feature’s contribution is explicitly weight-attributed and directionally verifiable. Meanwhile, the underlying features capture source structure, contextual surprise, and semantic coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 BTTF（B ack T o T he F uture），这是一种可读性模型，其构建原则是将传统的线性回归基础架构与新型信息论特征相结合。 BTTF 并未将大型语言模型视为不透明的端到端评判者，而是将预训练的因果语言模型和连续嵌入空间纯粹用作测量工具。 线性回归通过确保每个特征的贡献都能明确地归因于权重，并且其方向性可被验证，从而提供了透明度。 与此同时，其底层特征能够捕捉到源文本的结构、语境中的意外性以及语义连贯性。

sents.en: Linear regression provides transparency by ensuring that every feature’s contribution is explicitly weight-attributed and directionally verifiable.
sents.zh: 线性回归通过确保每个特征的贡献都能明确地归因于权重，并且其方向性可被验证，从而提供了透明度。

sents.en: Meanwhile, the underlying features capture source structure, contextual surprise, and semantic coherence.
sents.zh: 与此同时，其底层特征能够捕捉到源文本的结构、语境中的意外性以及语义连贯性。

paragraphs.en: To measure semantic coherence, BTTF leverages pretrained embedding spaces as geometric proxies for mental consolidation. Continuous embedding models place semantically related inputs near one another in representation space ( Nussbaum et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Günther et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . Coherent groups of identifiers and control structures reflect information that is readily consolidated by a reader, whereas fragmented distributions indicate elements that are more difficult to organise into common abstractions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量语义连贯性，BTTF 利用预训练的嵌入空间作为心智整合的几何代理。 连续嵌入模型将语义相关的输入在表示空间中彼此靠近（Nussbaum 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Günther 等，2023；Yu 等，2024）。 标识符和控制结构的连贯组别反映了读者能够轻松整合的信息，而碎片化的分布则表明这些元素更难组织成共同的抽象概念。

sents.en: To measure semantic coherence, BTTF leverages pretrained embedding spaces as geometric proxies for mental consolidation.
sents.zh: 为了衡量语义连贯性，BTTF 利用预训练的嵌入空间作为心智整合的几何代理。

sents.en: Continuous embedding models place semantically related inputs near one another in representation space ( Nussbaum et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Günther et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 连续嵌入模型将语义相关的输入在表示空间中彼此靠近（Nussbaum 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Günther 等，2023；Yu 等，2024）。

sents.en: Coherent groups of identifiers and control structures reflect information that is readily consolidated by a reader, whereas fragmented distributions indicate elements that are more difficult to organise into common abstractions.
sents.zh: 标识符和控制结构的连贯组别反映了读者能够轻松整合的信息，而碎片化的分布则表明这些元素更难组织成共同的抽象概念。

paragraphs.en: Embedding spaces capture which program elements are related, but not whether they appear where a reader would expect them, as, for example when unrelated logic is interleaved with the current computation. A name may be unexpected when first encountered, an assignment value may not follow from preceding statements, or a short identifier may require context from much earlier in the program. Causal code language models complement semantic organisation by measuring the prediction difficulty of observed source constructs, revealing which elements are unexpected and whether additional preceding context makes them easier to anticipate. Together, the measurements describe how source information forms semantic units, unfolds through the program, and relates to its preceding context.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入空间能够捕捉哪些程序元素之间存在关联，但无法反映这些元素是否出现在读者预期的位置，例如当无关的逻辑与当前计算相互交织时。 首次遇到某个名称时，它可能令人意外；某个赋值值可能无法从前述语句中推导出来；或者一个简短的标识符可能需要程序中更早位置的上下文信息才能理解。 因果代码语言模型通过衡量已观察到的源程序结构在预测上的难度，来补充语义组织方式，从而揭示哪些元素是出乎意料的，以及是否有额外的上下文信息能使其更容易被预测。 这些测量值共同描述了源程序信息如何形成语义单元、如何在程序中逐步展开，以及如何与其前文上下文相关联。

paragraphs.en: Based on this view, we use pretrained models as measurement instruments rather than as end-to-end readability predictors. Stability analysis and consensus ranking across three causal language models and five embedding models select features that remain useful under different pretrained representations. The resulting model contains 11 named, directly interpretable features: four traditional measurements of source complexity, two measurements of semantic organisation in embedding space, and five measurements of contextual prediction difficulty derived from causal code language models ( Table 1 defines all 11).
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一观点，我们将预训练模型用作测量工具，而非端到端的可读性预测器。 通过对三种因果语言模型和五种嵌入模型进行稳定性分析和共识排序，我们筛选出在不同预训练表示下仍具有实用价值的特征。 最终模型包含 11 个有名称且可直接解释的特征：四个衡量源文本复杂度的传统指标、两个衡量嵌入空间中语义组织程度的指标，以及五个从因果代码语言模型中推导出的上下文预测难度指标（表 1 定义了全部 11 个特征）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BTTF across the complete set of five publicly available human-rated code-readability benchmarks, supplemented by our manually annotated MBJP development set, for a total of 1,100 samples. Across this comprehensive suite, BTTF establishes a new state of the art under both pooled cross-validation and leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation, achieving average Spearman correlations of 0.631 and 0.638—gains of 0.094 and 0.101 over the strongest baseline average (paired 95% bootstrap CIs [0.031, 0.157] and [0.038, 0.165]; p ≤ 0.0032 p\leq 0.0032 ). Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations applied to production code, BTTF achieves expected-direction response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. It assigns lower readability to a majority of changed variants for every transformation in both languages. While approaching the robustness of opaque frontier models (falling within 1.7 and 5.1 percentage points of GPT-6.1 Sol without incurring remote generative overhead averaging 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation), BTTF provides feature-granular interpretability via signed contributions from 11 source properties, where every fitted coefficient strictly matches its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations ( Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在全部五个公开可用的人类评分代码可读性基准数据集上对 BTTF 进行了评估，并辅以我们手动标注的 MBJP 开发集，总计包含 1,100 个样本。 在这一系列全面的测试中，BTTF 在合并交叉验证和“留一数据集”（LODO）评估两种方法下均确立了新的最优水平，平均 Spearman 相关系数分别达到 0.631 和 0.638——相较于最强基线模型的平均值分别提升了 0.094 和 0.101（配对 95% 自助置信区间为 [0.031, 0.157] 和 [0.038, 0.165]；p ≤ 0.0032）。 在对生产代码应用的 13 种受控的可读性降低转换中，BTTF 在 Java 中的预期方向响应率为 93.8%，在 Python 中为 87.6%，分别比 Dorn 高出 14% 和 19.2%。 对于两种语言中的每种转换，BTTF 对大多数变化后的变体都赋予了较低的可读性评分。 尽管 BTTF 在稳健性上接近不透明的前沿模型（与 GPT-6.1 Sol 的差距在 1.7 至 5.1 个百分点之间，且无需承担每次评估平均 1,083 个提示词标记的远程生成开销），但它通过来自 11 个源属性的带符号贡献值提供了特征层面的可解释性，其中所有拟合的系数在所有评估的模型配置中均严格符合其理论上的方向性影响（表 6）。

paragraphs.en: This work makes three key contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本研究有三项关键贡献：

paragraphs.en: We introduce BTTF, an interpretable, linear regression model for readability that combines traditional code measurements with semantic organisation and information-theoretic predictability derived from pretrained models ( Section 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 BTTF，这是一种可解释的线性回归模型，用于评估可读性。该模型将传统的代码度量方法与语义组织以及从预训练模型中得出的信息论可预测性相结合（第 2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We show that BTTF achieves state-of-the-art Spearman correlations of 0.631 (pooled) and 0.638 (LODO), improving baseline averages by 0.094 and 0.101. It approaches GPT-6.1 Sol response rates with 93.8% (Java) and 87.6% (Python) transformation response rates without remote prompting or response generation, while ensuring fully interpretable feature contributions ( Tables 3 and 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，BTTF 实现了当前最先进的斯皮尔曼相关系数，分别为 0.631（合并）和 0.638（LODO），比基线模型的平均值分别提升了 0.094 和 0.101。 在没有远程提示或响应生成的情况下，其转换响应率达到了 93.8%（Java）和 87.6%（Python），接近 GPT-6.1 Sol 的响应率，同时确保了特征贡献完全可解释（表 3 和表 4）。

sents.en: We show that BTTF achieves state-of-the-art Spearman correlations of 0.631 (pooled) and 0.638 (LODO), improving baseline averages by 0.094 and 0.101.
sents.zh: 我们证明，BTTF 实现了当前最先进的斯皮尔曼相关系数，分别为 0.631（合并）和 0.638（LODO），比基线模型的平均值分别提升了 0.094 和 0.101。

sents.en: It approaches GPT-6.1 Sol response rates with 93.8% (Java) and 87.6% (Python) transformation response rates without remote prompting or response generation, while ensuring fully interpretable feature contributions ( Tables 3 and 4 ).
sents.zh: 在没有远程提示或响应生成的情况下，其转换响应率达到了 93.8%（Java）和 87.6%（Python），接近 GPT-6.1 Sol 的响应率，同时确保了特征贡献完全可解释（表 3 和表 4）。

paragraphs.en: We deliver unmatched interpretability: every feature in BTTF aligns with its theoretical effect without sign reversals across configurations ( Sections 4.4 and 6 ). In contrast, frontier LLMs such as GPT-6.1 overrate subtle code defects by relying on high-level summaries that fail to properly weigh combined property severities ( Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供无与伦比的解释性：BTTF 中的每个特征都与其理论效应一致，且在不同配置下不会出现符号反转（第 4.4 节和第 6 节）。 相比之下，前沿 LLM 如 GPT-6.1 依赖高层摘要来评估细微的代码缺陷，而这些摘要未能正确权衡组合属性严重性，导致高估了缺陷的影响（第 4.4 节）。

sents.zh: 我们提供无与伦比的解释性：BTTF 中的每个特征都与其理论效应一致，且在不同配置下不会出现符号反转（第 4.4 节和第 6 节）。

sents.zh: 相比之下，前沿 LLM 如 GPT-6.1 依赖高层摘要来评估细微的代码缺陷，而这些摘要未能正确权衡组合属性严重性，导致高估了缺陷的影响（第 4.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: BTTF models readability along two information dimensions: how compactly program elements organise into semantic abstractions, and how predictably information unfolds through the source. For the first, we extract AST-tagged code snippets and embed them individually. Geometric and clustering measurements then distinguish code whose identifiers and structures form a small number of coherent semantic groups from code whose elements remain dispersed. Such organisation reflects information compression: many source-level observations can be represented through fewer higher-level patterns.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 模型从两个信息维度评估可读性：程序元素以多紧凑的方式组织成语义抽象，以及信息在源代码中展开的可预测性。 对于第一个维度，我们提取带有 AST 标签的代码片段，并分别进行嵌入。 随后，通过几何和聚类测量方法，可以将标识符和结构形成少量连贯语义组的代码，与元素保持分散状态的代码区分开来。 这种组织方式体现了信息压缩：许多源代码层面的观察结果可以通过更少数量的更高层模式来表示。

sents.en: BTTF models readability along two information dimensions: how compactly program elements organise into semantic abstractions, and how predictably information unfolds through the source.
sents.zh: BTTF 模型从两个信息维度评估可读性：程序元素以多紧凑的方式组织成语义抽象，以及信息在源代码中展开的可预测性。

sents.en: For the first, we extract AST-tagged code snippets and embed them individually.
sents.zh: 对于第一个维度，我们提取带有 AST 标签的代码片段，并分别进行嵌入。

sents.en: Geometric and clustering measurements then distinguish code whose identifiers and structures form a small number of coherent semantic groups from code whose elements remain dispersed.
sents.zh: 随后，通过几何和聚类测量方法，可以将标识符和结构形成少量连贯语义组的代码，与元素保持分散状态的代码区分开来。

sents.en: Such organisation reflects information compression: many source-level observations can be represented through fewer higher-level patterns.
sents.zh: 这种组织方式体现了信息压缩：许多源代码层面的观察结果可以通过更少数量的更高层模式来表示。

paragraphs.en: For the second dimension, we use frozen causal code language models to measure the surprisal of observed source constructs. Rather than reduce an entire program to a single perplexity value, we locate where new information arises, which kinds of constructs are difficult to predict, and whether additional preceding context reduces that difficulty. These measurements capture the ordering and contextual support that embedding-space organisation alone cannot provide. The complete representation combines these two dimensions with traditional measurements of surface-level information properties.
paragraphs.zh: 对于第二个维度，我们使用冻结的因果代码语言模型来衡量观测到的源结构所带来的意外性。 我们并非将整个程序简化为一个单一的困惑度值，而是定位新信息出现的位置、哪些类型的结构难以预测，以及是否有额外的上下文内容能够降低这种预测难度。 这些测量方法捕捉到了嵌入空间组织本身无法提供的顺序关系和上下文支持。 完整的表示形式将这两个维度与传统对表层信息属性的测量相结合。

sents.en: For the second dimension, we use frozen causal code language models to measure the surprisal of observed source constructs.
sents.zh: 对于第二个维度，我们使用冻结的因果代码语言模型来衡量观测到的源结构所带来的意外性。

sents.en: Rather than reduce an entire program to a single perplexity value, we locate where new information arises, which kinds of constructs are difficult to predict, and whether additional preceding context reduces that difficulty.
sents.zh: 我们并非将整个程序简化为一个单一的困惑度值，而是定位新信息出现的位置、哪些类型的结构难以预测，以及是否有额外的上下文内容能够降低这种预测难度。

sents.en: These measurements capture the ordering and contextual support that embedding-space organisation alone cannot provide.
sents.zh: 这些测量方法捕捉到了嵌入空间组织本身无法提供的顺序关系和上下文支持。

sents.en: The complete representation combines these two dimensions with traditional measurements of surface-level information properties.
sents.zh: 完整的表示形式将这两个维度与传统对表层信息属性的测量相结合。

paragraphs.en: Embedding models operate on strings rather than program structures. We therefore extract source constructs as AST-tagged snippets and convert them into normalised representations. Raw source strings can mislead an embedding model: surface differences may obscure related program information, while compound expressions may blur distinct elements. We address these cases in opposite ways: compound constructs are decomposed so that their internal elements remain distinguishable, whereas elements that share a program role, such as literals, receive a common textual cue while retaining their original content. The resulting snippets provide the inputs for semantic-organisation measurements. We also compute traditional features directly from the source and extracted snippets to capture surface-level information properties. The resulting representation is illustrated in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入模型处理的是字符串，而非程序结构。 因此，我们将源程序结构提取为带有 AST 标签的代码片段，并将其转换为标准化表示。 原始源字符串可能会误导嵌入模型：表面差异可能掩盖相关的程序信息，而复合表达式则可能模糊不同元素之间的界限。 我们对这些情况采取相反的处理方式：将复合结构分解，使其内部元素保持可区分；而对于具有相同程序角色的元素（如字面量），则在保留原始内容的同时赋予它们共同的文本提示。 生成的代码片段为语义组织测量提供了输入。 我们还直接从源代码和提取出的代码片段中计算传统特征，以捕捉表面层的信息特性。 最终的表示形式如图 2 所示。

sents.zh: 嵌入模型处理的是字符串，而非程序结构。

paragraphs.en: Embeddings allow us to compare the semantic similarity of code snippets. We use these similarities for automatic clustering, which shows whether the snippets concentrate into a few coherent semantic groups or remain fragmented. The former reflects a compact higher-level organisation of program information; the latter reflects a larger set of distinct abstractions. To avoid relying on a single grouping assumption, we use multiple adaptive clustering methods and retain geometric measurements as complementary evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入表示使我们能够比较代码片段之间的语义相似度。 我们利用这些相似度进行自动聚类，以此判断这些片段是集中在少数几个连贯的语义组中，还是保持碎片化状态。 前者反映了程序信息的紧凑高层组织；后者则反映了一组更多且相互独立的抽象概念。 为避免依赖单一的分组假设，我们采用多种自适应聚类方法，并保留几何测量结果作为补充证据。

paragraphs.en: Lower values indicate stronger consistency with the preceding context. Prior work shows why a single aggregate is insufficient: whole-class cross-entropy alone is less effective than logical lines of code (LLOC) for predicting maintainability-related judgements ( Dillmann et al., 2024 ) . We therefore align token surprisal with AST-tagged source constructs and compute separate measurements for identifiers, literals, declarations, assignments, and other construct AST tags. We also compare the same targets under shorter and longer preceding contexts, revealing how much earlier source reduces their surprise. Complete feature definitions, model lists, normalisation, and calibration procedures appear in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 数值越低，表示与先前语境的一致性越强。 先前的研究揭示了为何单一聚合指标不足：仅使用整个类的交叉熵在预测可维护性相关的判断时，效果不如逻辑代码行（LLOC）（Dillmann 等，2024）。 因此，我们将词元意外性与带有 AST 标签的源代码结构进行对齐，并为标识符、字面量、声明、赋值及其他结构 AST 标签分别计算度量值。 我们还比较了较短和较长先前语境下相同目标的情况，以揭示早期源代码能在多大程度上降低其意外性。 完整的特征定义、模型列表、归一化和校准流程见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: We first exclude candidates whose definitions are not portable or do not support clear interpretation, preventing them from influencing the selection of valid measurements. The remaining candidates are evaluated on the pooled six datasets separately under each pretrained-model configuration. We then combine the rankings of the same feature across configurations, favouring measurements that remain stable when the pretrained models change. BTTF retains the literal top 11 positions of this consensus ranking. Across all six datasets, adding lower-ranked features beyond these 11 produces only small, dataset-dependent changes in performance. Complete eligibility rules, ranking procedures, feature budgets, and candidate audits appear in Appendix B . For comparison, we also retain the independently selected 18-feature embedding-only model developed before causal-LM measurements were introduced; it is a historical predecessor rather than a post-hoc ablation of BTTF.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先排除那些定义不可移植或无法支持清晰解释的候选项，以防止它们影响有效测量值的选择。 在每种预训练模型配置下，我们对剩余的候选项分别基于合并后的六个数据集进行评估。 接着，我们将同一特征在不同配置中的排名进行整合，优先选择那些在预训练模型变化时仍能保持稳定的测量值。 BTTF 保留该共识排名中前 11 名的原始位置。 在所有六个数据集中，添加超出这 11 个之外的低排名特征，只会对性能产生微小且依赖数据集的变化。 完整的资格规则、排名流程、特征预算和候选项审核内容见附录 B。 作为对比，我们还保留了在引入因果-LM 测量之前独立开发的包含 18 个特征的纯嵌入模型；它是一个历史前身，而非 BTTF 的事后消融版本。

paragraphs.en: The final BTTF model uses 11 features: four traditional measurements, two embedding-derived measurements, and five causal-LM predictability measurements. They are summarised in Table 1 . All features are oriented towards increasing information or reading demand. Complete mathematical definitions are provided in Appendix A ; the fitted directions and their stability across pretrained models are examined in section 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 最终的 BTTF 模型使用了 11 个特征：四个传统测量值、两个嵌入衍生测量值以及五个因果语言模型可预测性测量值。 这些特征在表 1 中进行了总结。 所有特征都旨在增加信息量或阅读需求。 完整的数学定义见附录 A；拟合方向及其在预训练模型中的稳定性将在第 4 节中进行考察。

paragraphs.en: The four traditional features describe surface-level properties of expressions and layout. Operator density measures how many operations a reader must parse within each non-empty source line. From an information-theoretic perspective, it records the concentration of symbolic transformations within the same reading unit.
paragraphs.zh: 这四项传统特征描述了表达和布局的表面属性。 算子密度衡量了读者在每一行非空源文本中需要解析的操作数量。 从信息论的角度来看，它记录了同一阅读单元内符号转换的集中程度。

sents.en: The four traditional features describe surface-level properties of expressions and layout.
sents.zh: 这四项传统特征描述了表达和布局的表面属性。

sents.en: Operator density measures how many operations a reader must parse within each non-empty source line.
sents.zh: 算子密度衡量了读者在每一行非空源文本中需要解析的操作数量。

sents.en: From an information-theoretic perspective, it records the concentration of symbolic transformations within the same reading unit.
sents.zh: 从信息论的角度来看，它记录了同一阅读单元内符号转换的集中程度。

paragraphs.en: Decision density measures the concentration of relational and equality comparisons. Each comparison distinguishes between possible program states, and the feature records how many such alternatives occur within each non-empty source line.
paragraphs.zh: 决策密度衡量了关系比较和相等比较的集中程度。 每次比较都会区分可能的程序状态，而该特征则记录每个非空源行中出现了多少种这样的可能性。

sents.en: Decision density measures the concentration of relational and equality comparisons.
sents.zh: 决策密度衡量了关系比较和相等比较的集中程度。

sents.en: Each comparison distinguishes between possible program states, and the feature records how many such alternatives occur within each non-empty source line.
sents.zh: 每次比较都会区分可能的程序状态，而该特征则记录每个非空源行中出现了多少种这样的可能性。

paragraphs.en: Longest line length records the length of the longest non-empty line. A longer uninterrupted span presents more source information before a line boundary provides a natural segmentation point.
paragraphs.zh: 最长行长度记录了最长非空行的长度。 更长的不间断跨度在到达行界之前提供了更多源信息，从而构成了一个自然的分段点。

paragraphs.en: The two embedding features ask whether the concepts within a program form a small, coherent organisation or are scattered across several distinct semantic regions.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种嵌入特征旨在判断程序中的概念是构成一个小型、连贯的组织，还是分散在几个不同的语义区域中。

paragraphs.en: Computation-and-control pattern count groups control-flow, assignment, arithmetic, comparison, logical, and bitwise snippets according to their semantic similarity and counts the automatically identified groups. Recurring and conventional forms are absorbed into the same groups and add little new organisational information, whereas constructs that do not fit those groups require additional patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 计算与控制模式计数根据语义相似性将控制流、赋值、算术运算、比较、逻辑和位操作片段分组，并对自动识别出的组进行计数。 重复出现和常规的形式会被归入同一组，并几乎不增加新的组织信息；而那些无法融入这些组的结构则需要额外的模式。

sents.en: Computation-and-control pattern count groups control-flow, assignment, arithmetic, comparison, logical, and bitwise snippets according to their semantic similarity and counts the automatically identified groups.
sents.zh: 计算与控制模式计数根据语义相似性将控制流、赋值、算术运算、比较、逻辑和位操作片段分组，并对自动识别出的组进行计数。

paragraphs.en: Identifier embedding dispersion measures whether the identifier meanings follow a common semantic direction or spread across several unrelated directions. It is computed as one minus the fraction of identifier-embedding variance explained by the first principal component, recording how broadly the identifier meanings spread beyond a common direction.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符嵌入离散度衡量的是标识符的含义是否遵循一个共同的语义方向，还是分散到多个无关的方向。 它的计算方式为 1 减去由第一主成分所解释的标识符嵌入方差的比例，从而记录标识符的含义在共同方向之外扩散的程度。

paragraphs.en: Literal-tail surprisal first computes BPB separately for literal occurrences and averages the most difficult 20%. It targets exceptional constants or encodings that may be hidden by an otherwise predictable snippet. Identifier-onset surprisal measures the surprisal allocated to the first tokenizer piece of every identifier. The first piece carries the initial lexical cue to a name and isolates its predictability at first encounter. Assignment-value surprisal measures the byte-weighted prediction difficulty of initializer and assignment right-hand sides, capturing how readily a reader can anticipate the computations that produce stored values.
paragraphs.zh: 字面尾部意外性首先分别计算字面出现时的BPB，然后对最困难的20%取平均值。 它针对那些可能被原本可预测的片段所掩盖的特殊常量或编码。 标识符开头意外性衡量分配给每个标识符首个分词单元的预期性。 首个分词单元携带了名称的初始词汇线索，并隔离了首次接触时的可预测性。 赋值值意外性衡量初始化器和赋值右侧表达式的字节加权预测难度，反映读者能多容易地预判生成存储值的计算过程。

sents.en: Literal-tail surprisal first computes BPB separately for literal occurrences and averages the most difficult 20%.
sents.zh: 字面尾部意外性首先分别计算字面出现时的BPB，然后对最困难的20%取平均值。

sents.en: It targets exceptional constants or encodings that may be hidden by an otherwise predictable snippet.
sents.zh: 它针对那些可能被原本可预测的片段所掩盖的特殊常量或编码。

sents.en: Identifier-onset surprisal measures the surprisal allocated to the first tokenizer piece of every identifier.
sents.zh: 标识符开头意外性衡量分配给每个标识符首个分词单元的预期性。

sents.en: The first piece carries the initial lexical cue to a name and isolates its predictability at first encounter.
sents.zh: 首个分词单元携带了名称的初始词汇线索，并隔离了首次接触时的可预测性。

sents.en: Assignment-value surprisal measures the byte-weighted prediction difficulty of initializer and assignment right-hand sides, capturing how readily a reader can anticipate the computations that produce stored values.
sents.zh: 赋值值意外性衡量初始化器和赋值右侧表达式的字节加权预测难度，反映读者能多容易地预判生成存储值的计算过程。

paragraphs.en: Declaration-surprisal variation measures how consistently declarations can be anticipated within the same source unit. We first calculate BPB separately for each variable declaration or function signature, considering the declaration itself rather than its body or assigned value, and then measure the variation among them. The resulting feature distinguishes uniform declaration predictability from mixtures of conventional and unexpected forms.
paragraphs.zh: 声明-意外性变异衡量了同一源单元内声明被预测的一致性程度。 我们首先为每个变量声明或函数签名单独计算 BPB，其中仅考虑声明本身而非其主体或赋值内容，然后测量它们之间的变异。 由此得到的特征能够区分统一的声明可预测性与常规形式和意外形式混合的情况。

sents.en: Declaration-surprisal variation measures how consistently declarations can be anticipated within the same source unit.
sents.zh: 声明-意外性变异衡量了同一源单元内声明被预测的一致性程度。

sents.en: We first calculate BPB separately for each variable declaration or function signature, considering the declaration itself rather than its body or assigned value, and then measure the variation among them.
sents.zh: 我们首先为每个变量声明或函数签名单独计算 BPB，其中仅考虑声明本身而非其主体或赋值内容，然后测量它们之间的变异。

sents.en: The resulting feature distinguishes uniform declaration predictability from mixtures of conventional and unexpected forms.
sents.zh: 由此得到的特征能够区分统一的声明可预测性与常规形式和意外形式混合的情况。

paragraphs.en: Finally, short-identifier context dependence compares each eligible short identifier under 32-token and 256-token preceding contexts, with gain g = BPB 32 − BPB 256 g=\operatorname{BPB}_{32}-\operatorname{BPB}_{256} . The mean gain records how much the prediction of short identifiers relies on farther preceding code rather than their immediate surroundings.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，短标识符上下文依赖性会分别比较每个符合条件的短标识符在 32 个标记和 256 个标记的前文上下文中的表现，其增益为 g = BPB₃₂ − BPB₂₅₆。 平均增益记录了短标识符的预测在多大程度上依赖更远处的先前代码，而非其直接周围环境。

sents.en: Finally, short-identifier context dependence compares each eligible short identifier under 32-token and 256-token preceding contexts, with gain g = BPB 32 − BPB 256 g=\operatorname{BPB}_{32}-\operatorname{BPB}_{256} .
sents.zh: 最后，短标识符上下文依赖性会分别比较每个符合条件的短标识符在 32 个标记和 256 个标记的前文上下文中的表现，其增益为 g = BPB₃₂ − BPB₂₅₆。

sents.en: The mean gain records how much the prediction of short identifiers relies on farther preceding code rather than their immediate surroundings.
sents.zh: 平均增益记录了短标识符的预测在多大程度上依赖更远处的先前代码，而非其直接周围环境。

paragraphs.en: We use two main forms of evaluation. First, the complete set of five publicly available human-rated code-readability benchmarks, together with our MBJP development set, measures agreement with human judgements and transfer across datasets. Second, controlled source-code interference experiments measure whether predictions decrease under targeted readability reductions in Java and Python. The following research questions specify the comparisons and analyses conducted within these two evaluation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两种主要形式的评估。 首先，完整的五个人工标注代码可读性公开基准数据集，以及我们的 MBJP 开发集，用于衡量与人类判断的一致性以及在不同数据集上的迁移能力。 其次，受控源代码干扰实验用于衡量在 Java 和 Python 中针对可读性进行削弱时，预测结果是否会下降。 以下研究问题明确了在这两种评估设置中所进行的比较和分析。

sents.en: We use two main forms of evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们使用两种主要形式的评估。

sents.en: First, the complete set of five publicly available human-rated code-readability benchmarks, together with our MBJP development set, measures agreement with human judgements and transfer across datasets.
sents.zh: 首先，完整的五个人工标注代码可读性公开基准数据集，以及我们的 MBJP 开发集，用于衡量与人类判断的一致性以及在不同数据集上的迁移能力。

sents.en: Second, controlled source-code interference experiments measure whether predictions decrease under targeted readability reductions in Java and Python.
sents.zh: 其次，受控源代码干扰实验用于衡量在 Java 和 Python 中针对可读性进行削弱时，预测结果是否会下降。

sents.en: The following research questions specify the comparisons and analyses conducted within these two evaluation settings.
sents.zh: 以下研究问题明确了在这两种评估设置中所进行的比较和分析。

paragraphs.en: We organise the evaluation around four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将评估围绕四个研究问题展开：

paragraphs.en: Does BTTF align more closely with human readability judgements than existing models do?
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 是否与现有模型相比，更符合人类的可读性判断？

paragraphs.en: Does BTTF respond more consistently to controlled readability-reducing transformations than existing models do?
paragraphs.zh: 与现有模型相比，BTTF 对受控的、降低可读性的变换是否表现出更一致的反应？

paragraphs.en: We aggregate the complete set of human labelled code-readability and cognitive-complexity benchmarks established in the software engineering literature: Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains. To our knowledge, they represent the total corpus of public benchmarks evaluated across prior literature on this topic. We supplement this literature-wide set with our manually labelled MBJP development set, yielding a unified benchmark of 1,100 human-rated code snippets. The suite spans Java, Python, and CUDA code at snippet, method, class, file, and program granularity, with targets derived from mean label values, posterior expectations, or readable-vote fractions. The six datasets are summarised in Table 2 . Detailed target construction, annotation statistics, and the MBJP development-set procedure are reported in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们整合了软件工程文献中已确立的、由人类标注的完整代码可读性与认知复杂度基准数据集：Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains。 据我们所知，这些数据集构成了此前相关文献中所有已评估的公开基准数据集的总和。 我们将这一涵盖整个文献领域的数据集，与我们手动标注的 MBJP 开发集相结合，从而形成一个包含 1,100 条人类评分代码片段的统一基准。 该基准套件涵盖了 Java、Python 和 CUDA 代码，并细分为代码片段、方法、类、文件和程序等不同粒度；其目标值则基于平均标注值、后验期望或可读性投票比例确定。 这六个数据集在表 2 中进行了总结。 详细的目标构建过程、标注统计数据以及 MBJP 开发集的生成流程，均报告于附录 C 中。

sents.en: We aggregate the complete set of human labelled code-readability and cognitive-complexity benchmarks established in the software engineering literature: Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains.
sents.zh: 我们整合了软件工程文献中已确立的、由人类标注的完整代码可读性与认知复杂度基准数据集：Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains。

sents.en: To our knowledge, they represent the total corpus of public benchmarks evaluated across prior literature on this topic.
sents.zh: 据我们所知，这些数据集构成了此前相关文献中所有已评估的公开基准数据集的总和。

sents.en: We supplement this literature-wide set with our manually labelled MBJP development set, yielding a unified benchmark of 1,100 human-rated code snippets.
sents.zh: 我们将这一涵盖整个文献领域的数据集，与我们手动标注的 MBJP 开发集相结合，从而形成一个包含 1,100 条人类评分代码片段的统一基准。

sents.en: The suite spans Java, Python, and CUDA code at snippet, method, class, file, and program granularity, with targets derived from mean label values, posterior expectations, or readable-vote fractions.
sents.zh: 该基准套件涵盖了 Java、Python 和 CUDA 代码，并细分为代码片段、方法、类、文件和程序等不同粒度；其目标值则基于平均标注值、后验期望或可读性投票比例确定。

sents.en: The six datasets are summarised in Table 2 .
sents.zh: 这六个数据集在表 2 中进行了总结。

sents.en: Detailed target construction, annotation statistics, and the MBJP development-set procedure are reported in Appendix C .
sents.zh: 详细的目标构建过程、标注统计数据以及 MBJP 开发集的生成流程，均报告于附录 C 中。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the final 11-feature representation across six established or manually annotated readability datasets: MBJP, Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains. We additionally report the complete 18-feature embedding-only model obtained before causal-LM features were introduced; these predecessor results are placed in Appendix F . Its reference instance uses jina-embeddings-v2-base-code , matching the embedding representation used by BTTF.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在六个已建立或经人工标注的可读性数据集（MBJP、Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains）上评估了最终的 11 个特征表示。 我们还报告了在引入因果-LM 特征之前获得的完整 18 个特征的嵌入模型结果；这些早期结果已置于附录 F 中。 其参考实例使用了 jina-embeddings-v2-base-code，这与 BTTF 使用的嵌入表示一致。

sents.en: We evaluate the final 11-feature representation across six established or manually annotated readability datasets: MBJP, Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains.
sents.zh: 我们在六个已建立或经人工标注的可读性数据集（MBJP、Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains）上评估了最终的 11 个特征表示。

sents.en: We additionally report the complete 18-feature embedding-only model obtained before causal-LM features were introduced; these predecessor results are placed in Appendix F .
sents.zh: 我们还报告了在引入因果-LM 特征之前获得的完整 18 个特征的嵌入模型结果；这些早期结果已置于附录 F 中。

sents.en: Its reference instance uses jina-embeddings-v2-base-code , matching the embedding representation used by BTTF.
sents.zh: 其参考实例使用了 jina-embeddings-v2-base-code，这与 BTTF 使用的嵌入表示一致。

paragraphs.en: BTTF uses Ridge regression ( Hoerl and Kennard, 1970 ) with α = 200 \alpha=200 to predict continuous readability scores. Because the six datasets use different rating scales, their human scores are converted to percentile ranks within each dataset. During joint training, every dataset receives equal total weight, preventing larger datasets from dominating BTTF’s fit. Within each evaluation fold, missing-value imputation, range clipping, and feature standardisation are estimated from the training partition and applied unchanged to the test partition. Predictions are bounded to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with larger values indicating greater readability.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 使用岭回归（Hoerl 和 Kennard，1970），其中 α = 200 \alpha=200，来预测连续的易读性得分。 由于六个数据集使用了不同的评分量表，因此它们的人类评分被转换为每个数据集内的百分位排名。 在联合训练期间，每个数据集都获得相等的总权重，从而防止较大的数据集主导 BTTF 的拟合过程。 在每个评估折中，缺失值填补、范围裁剪和特征标准化均基于训练分区进行估计，并原样应用于测试分区。 预测值被限制在 [0,1] 范围内，数值越大表示易读性越高。

sents.en: BTTF uses Ridge regression ( Hoerl and Kennard, 1970 ) with α = 200 \alpha=200 to predict continuous readability scores.
sents.zh: BTTF 使用岭回归（Hoerl 和 Kennard，1970），其中 α = 200 \alpha=200，来预测连续的易读性得分。

sents.en: Because the six datasets use different rating scales, their human scores are converted to percentile ranks within each dataset.
sents.zh: 由于六个数据集使用了不同的评分量表，因此它们的人类评分被转换为每个数据集内的百分位排名。

sents.en: During joint training, every dataset receives equal total weight, preventing larger datasets from dominating BTTF’s fit.
sents.zh: 在联合训练期间，每个数据集都获得相等的总权重，从而防止较大的数据集主导 BTTF 的拟合过程。

sents.en: Within each evaluation fold, missing-value imputation, range clipping, and feature standardisation are estimated from the training partition and applied unchanged to the test partition.
sents.zh: 在每个评估折中，缺失值填补、范围裁剪和特征标准化均基于训练分区进行估计，并原样应用于测试分区。

sents.en: Predictions are bounded to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , with larger values indicating greater readability.
sents.zh: 预测值被限制在 [0,1] 范围内，数值越大表示易读性越高。

paragraphs.en: We use two evaluation protocols: pooled 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation. In pooled cross-validation, each dataset is divided into ten folds; in each round, a single Ridge model is trained on nine folds from every dataset and evaluated on the remaining folds. The reported correlations are computed exclusively from these out-of-fold predictions. In LODO evaluation, BTTF is trained on five complete datasets and evaluated on the sixth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用两种评估协议：合并式 10 折交叉验证和“留一数据集”（LODO）评估。 在合并式交叉验证中，每个数据集被划分为十折；每一轮中，基于每个数据集的九折数据训练一个 Ridge 模型，并在剩余的折上进行评估。 所报告的关联系数完全基于这些折外预测结果计算得出。 在 LODO 评估中，BTTF 基于五个完整的数据集进行训练，并在第六个数据集上进行评估。

sents.en: We use two evaluation protocols: pooled 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们使用两种评估协议：合并式 10 折交叉验证和“留一数据集”（LODO）评估。

sents.en: In pooled cross-validation, each dataset is divided into ten folds; in each round, a single Ridge model is trained on nine folds from every dataset and evaluated on the remaining folds.
sents.zh: 在合并式交叉验证中，每个数据集被划分为十折；每一轮中，基于每个数据集的九折数据训练一个 Ridge 模型，并在剩余的折上进行评估。

sents.en: The reported correlations are computed exclusively from these out-of-fold predictions.
sents.zh: 所报告的关联系数完全基于这些折外预测结果计算得出。

sents.en: In LODO evaluation, BTTF is trained on five complete datasets and evaluated on the sixth.
sents.zh: 在 LODO 评估中，BTTF 基于五个完整的数据集进行训练，并在第六个数据集上进行评估。

paragraphs.en: For each dataset separately, performance is measured using Spearman’s ρ \rho between predicted and human readability scores. For JetBrains, the human score is the proportion of reviewers who judged each snippet readable rather than a derived binary label. We compare BTTF with logical lines of code (LLOC), Posnett, Scalabrino, a reconstruction of Dorn, and a reproduction of Mi et al.’s ConvNetCR model. For the direct-prompting baseline, we apply the best-performing zero-shot prompt reported by Ouédraogo et al. ( Ouédraogo et al., 2025 ) to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, a state-of-the-art open model, and GPT-6.1 Sol, a state-of-the-art model. We query each direct-LLM baseline three times for every sample and use the mean score in all analyses. Full specifications appear in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个数据集，我们分别使用预测可读性得分与人类可读性得分之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ \rho 来衡量性能。 对于 JetBrains，人类评分是指认为每个代码片段可读的评审者比例，而非一个派生出的二元标签。 我们将 BTTF 与逻辑代码行（LLOC）、Posnett、Scalabrino、Dorn 的重建模型以及 Mi 等人提出的 ConvNetCR 模型的复现版本进行比较。 对于直接提示基线模型，我们采用 Ouédraogo 等人报告的最佳零样本提示。 （Ouédraogo 等人，2025）将其应用于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813（一个当前最先进的开放模型）和 GPT-6.1 Sol（一个当前最先进的模型）。 对于每个直接 LLM 基线模型，我们对每个样本进行三次查询，并在所有分析中使用平均得分。 完整规格见附录 D。

sents.en: For each dataset separately, performance is measured using Spearman’s ρ \rho between predicted and human readability scores.
sents.zh: 对于每个数据集，我们分别使用预测可读性得分与人类可读性得分之间的斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ \rho 来衡量性能。

sents.en: For JetBrains, the human score is the proportion of reviewers who judged each snippet readable rather than a derived binary label.
sents.zh: 对于 JetBrains，人类评分是指认为每个代码片段可读的评审者比例，而非一个派生出的二元标签。

sents.en: We compare BTTF with logical lines of code (LLOC), Posnett, Scalabrino, a reconstruction of Dorn, and a reproduction of Mi et al.’s ConvNetCR model.
sents.zh: 我们将 BTTF 与逻辑代码行（LLOC）、Posnett、Scalabrino、Dorn 的重建模型以及 Mi 等人提出的 ConvNetCR 模型的复现版本进行比较。

sents.en: For the direct-prompting baseline, we apply the best-performing zero-shot prompt reported by Ouédraogo et al.
sents.zh: 对于直接提示基线模型，我们采用 Ouédraogo 等人报告的最佳零样本提示。

sents.en: ( Ouédraogo et al., 2025 ) to DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, a state-of-the-art open model, and GPT-6.1 Sol, a state-of-the-art model.
sents.zh: （Ouédraogo 等人，2025）将其应用于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813（一个当前最先进的开放模型）和 GPT-6.1 Sol（一个当前最先进的模型）。

sents.en: We query each direct-LLM baseline three times for every sample and use the mean score in all analyses.
sents.zh: 对于每个直接 LLM 基线模型，我们对每个样本进行三次查询，并在所有分析中使用平均得分。

sents.en: Full specifications appear in Appendix D .
sents.zh: 完整规格见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether readability models respond in the expected direction to controlled reductions in readability, we evaluate the frozen BTTF and the comparison methods on parallel Java and Python interference datasets constructed from eight well-maintained open-source projects. The Java corpus is drawn from Guava, Spring Framework, Netty, and Apache Kafka, while the Python corpus is drawn from Django, Flask, Requests, and attrs. For each language, we select 25 complete production classes from each project, resulting in 100 Java classes and 100 Python classes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验可读性模型在对可控降低可读性的操作下是否以预期方向作出响应，我们在由八个维护良好的开源项目构建的并行 Java 和 Python 干扰数据集上，评估了冻结的 BTTF 模型以及对比方法。 Java 语料库来自 Guava、Spring Framework、Netty 和 Apache Kafka，而 Python 语料库则来自 Django、Flask、Requests 和 attrs。 对于每种语言，我们从每个项目中选取 25 个完整的生产类，最终得到 100 个 Java 类和 100 个 Python 类。

sents.en: To examine whether readability models respond in the expected direction to controlled reductions in readability, we evaluate the frozen BTTF and the comparison methods on parallel Java and Python interference datasets constructed from eight well-maintained open-source projects.
sents.zh: 为了检验可读性模型在对可控降低可读性的操作下是否以预期方向作出响应，我们在由八个维护良好的开源项目构建的并行 Java 和 Python 干扰数据集上，评估了冻结的 BTTF 模型以及对比方法。

sents.en: The Java corpus is drawn from Guava, Spring Framework, Netty, and Apache Kafka, while the Python corpus is drawn from Django, Flask, Requests, and attrs.
sents.zh: Java 语料库来自 Guava、Spring Framework、Netty 和 Apache Kafka，而 Python 语料库则来自 Django、Flask、Requests 和 attrs。

sents.en: For each language, we select 25 complete production classes from each project, resulting in 100 Java classes and 100 Python classes.
sents.zh: 对于每种语言，我们从每个项目中选取 25 个完整的生产类，最终得到 100 个 Java 类和 100 个 Python 类。

paragraphs.en: We define 13 source-level transformations, organised into seven categories:
paragraphs.zh: 我们定义了 13 种源级转换，并将其分为七类：

paragraphs.en: Comment transformation: removal of Java line comments, block comments, and Javadoc, and Python line comments and docstrings.
paragraphs.zh: 注释转换：移除 Java 行注释、块注释和 Javadoc，以及 Python 行注释和文档字符串。

paragraphs.en: Identifier transformations: identifier shortening, replacement with length-matched but semantically unrelated names, and deterministic minification. Eligible method, parameter, and local-variable names follow language-specific binding and collision constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符转换：包括标识符缩短、用长度匹配但语义无关的名称替换，以及确定性最小化。 符合条件的函数、参数和局部变量名称需遵循语言特定的绑定和冲突约束。

sents.en: Identifier transformations: identifier shortening, replacement with length-matched but semantically unrelated names, and deterministic minification.
sents.zh: 标识符转换：包括标识符缩短、用长度匹配但语义无关的名称替换，以及确定性最小化。

sents.en: Eligible method, parameter, and local-variable names follow language-specific binding and collision constraints.
sents.zh: 符合条件的函数、参数和局部变量名称需遵循语言特定的绑定和冲突约束。

paragraphs.en: Expression transformations: hexadecimal rewriting of decimal integer literals and inversion of conditions with corresponding branch exchange.
paragraphs.zh: 表达式转换：将十进制整数字面量转换为十六进制形式，并对条件进行反转，同时交换相应的分支。

paragraphs.en: Code-injection transformations: insertion of unreachable branches, readable unrelated code, and low-readability unrelated code. The latter two are selected deterministically from ten template families each.
paragraphs.zh: 代码注入转换：插入不可达分支、可读性强的无关代码以及可读性差的无关代码。 后两种类型均从各自十个模板族中通过确定性方式选择。

sents.en: Code-injection transformations: insertion of unreachable branches, readable unrelated code, and low-readability unrelated code.
sents.zh: 代码注入转换：插入不可达分支、可读性强的无关代码以及可读性差的无关代码。

sents.en: The latter two are selected deterministically from ten template families each.
sents.zh: 后两种类型均从各自十个模板族中通过确定性方式选择。

paragraphs.en: Layout transformation: partial removal of newline-containing whitespace while retaining some visual structure, with separate eligibility rules for Python indentation.
paragraphs.zh: 布局转换：部分移除包含换行符的空格，同时保留部分视觉结构，并对 Python 缩进适用独立的资格规则。

paragraphs.en: Data-flow transformations: replacement of integer literals with two short-named local variables whose sum preserves the value, and inlining of eligible single-use local variables at their sole use site.
paragraphs.zh: 数据流转换：将整数字面量替换为两个短命名的局部变量，其和保持原值不变；并将符合条件的单次使用的局部变量在其唯一的使用位置进行内联。

paragraphs.en: Control-flow transformation: conversion of eligible for loops into while -based forms, covering classic and enhanced loops in Java and synchronous loops through explicit iterators in Python.
paragraphs.zh: 控制流转换：将符合条件的 for 循环转换为基于 while 的形式，涵盖 Java 中的经典循环和增强型循环，以及 Python 中通过显式迭代器实现的同步循环。

paragraphs.en: These transformations reverse readability improvements repeatedly identified in prior work, including improving names, replacing opaque literals, expressing conditions positively, simplifying loops, removing unused code, restoring visual structure, and adding or clarifying documentation ( Buse and Weimer, 2009 ; Scalabrino et al., 2018 ; Dantas et al., 2023 ; Sergeyuk et al., 2024 ) . Related perturbation-based studies have likewise used identifier erosion, misleading replacement, dead-branch injection, irrelevant-variable injection, and expression rewrites to construct lower-readability code ( Hu et al., 2024 ) . All 13 transformations therefore have a clear expected direction towards lower readability.
paragraphs.zh: 这些转换反复推翻了先前研究中已多次确认的增强可读性的方法，包括改进命名、替换晦涩的常量、以肯定形式表达条件、简化循环、移除未使用的代码、恢复视觉结构以及添加或澄清文档（Buse 和 Weimer，2009；Scalabrino 等，2018；Dantas 等，2023；Sergeyuk 等，2024）。 相关的基于扰动研究同样利用标识符退化、误导性替换、死分支注入、无关变量注入和表达式重写来构建可读性更低的代码（Hu 等，2024）。 因此，这 13 种转换都具有一个明确的预期方向，即降低可读性。

paragraphs.en: The Java and Python datasets use the same 13 transformations, organised into the same seven categories, with language-specific adaptations where required. Each transformation is applied independently to the original class rather than to the output of another transformation, allowing its effect to be evaluated without interactions from other interference types.
paragraphs.zh: Java 和 Python 数据集使用了相同的 13 种转换方法，这些方法被组织为相同的七个类别，并在需要时进行了语言特定的调整。 每种转换都独立应用于原始类，而不是应用于其他转换的输出，这使得可以在没有其他干扰类型相互作用的情况下评估其效果。

sents.en: The Java and Python datasets use the same 13 transformations, organised into the same seven categories, with language-specific adaptations where required.
sents.zh: Java 和 Python 数据集使用了相同的 13 种转换方法，这些方法被组织为相同的七个类别，并在需要时进行了语言特定的调整。

sents.en: Each transformation is applied independently to the original class rather than to the output of another transformation, allowing its effect to be evaluated without interactions from other interference types.
sents.zh: 每种转换都独立应用于原始类，而不是应用于其他转换的输出，这使得可以在没有其他干扰类型相互作用的情况下评估其效果。

paragraphs.en: For each language, the dataset contains 100 original classes and 1,300 independently transformed variants, yielding 1,400 samples per language and 2,800 samples in total. We take several steps to preserve source consistency wherever possible: identifier edits follow local bindings, newly introduced names avoid collisions, and structural transformations update the affected code within the same source unit. We retain only complete samples that pass language-specific parsing. Detailed transformation rules, validation procedures, and eligibility constraints are provided in Appendix E .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种语言，数据集都包含 100 个原始类和 1,300 个独立变换的变体，因此每种语言有 1,400 个样本，总共 2,800 个样本。 我们采取若干步骤，在尽可能保留源一致性的同时进行操作：标识符的修改遵循本地绑定，新引入的名称避免冲突，结构变换则在同一源单元内更新受影响的代码。 我们仅保留通过语言特定解析的完整样本。 详细的变换规则、验证流程以及资格限制见附录 E。

sents.zh: 对于每种语言，数据集都包含 100 个原始类和 1,300 个独立变换的变体，因此每种语言有 1,400 个样本，总共 2,800 个样本。

sents.en: We retain only complete samples that pass language-specific parsing.
sents.zh: 我们仅保留通过语言特定解析的完整样本。

sents.en: Detailed transformation rules, validation procedures, and eligibility constraints are provided in Appendix E .
sents.zh: 详细的变换规则、验证流程以及资格限制见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: BTTF contains 11 features selected from the complete candidate set. We first evaluate its agreement with human ratings across six readability benchmarks and measure its response to controlled readability reductions in Java and Python. We then use a human-rated example to contrast direct LLM judgements with BTTF’s feature-level attribution, before examining its robustness across pretrained-model combinations, including the stability of the learned feature directions. Finally, we evaluate the contribution of its three feature families and compare it with the independently selected 18-feature embedding-only predecessor.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 包含从完整候选集中选出的 11 个特征。 我们首先评估它在六个可读性基准测试中与人类评分的一致性，并测量它对 Java 和 Python 中受控可读性降低的反应。 接着，我们使用一个经过人类评分的示例，将直接的 LLM 判断与 BTTF 的特征级归因进行对比，然后考察其在不同预训练模型组合下的稳健性，包括所学习特征方向的稳定性。 最后，我们评估其三个特征家族的贡献度，并将其与先前独立选出的 18 个特征的纯嵌入模型进行比较。

sents.en: BTTF contains 11 features selected from the complete candidate set.
sents.zh: BTTF 包含从完整候选集中选出的 11 个特征。

sents.en: We first evaluate its agreement with human ratings across six readability benchmarks and measure its response to controlled readability reductions in Java and Python.
sents.zh: 我们首先评估它在六个可读性基准测试中与人类评分的一致性，并测量它对 Java 和 Python 中受控可读性降低的反应。

sents.zh: 接着，我们使用一个经过人类评分的示例，将直接的 LLM 判断与 BTTF 的特征级归因进行对比，然后考察其在不同预训练模型组合下的稳健性，包括所学习特征方向的稳定性。

sents.en: Finally, we evaluate the contribution of its three feature families and compare it with the independently selected 18-feature embedding-only predecessor.
sents.zh: 最后，我们评估其三个特征家族的贡献度，并将其与先前独立选出的 18 个特征的纯嵌入模型进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We compare BTTF with the readability baselines in Table 3 under pooled 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation. The reference configuration uses jina-embeddings-v2-base-code and OpenCoder-1.5B-Base . Results for all 15 combinations of embedding and causal language models are reported in section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 3 中，通过合并 10 折交叉验证和“留一数据集”（LODO）评估方法，将 BTTF 与可读性基线模型进行了比较。 参考配置使用了 jina-embeddings-v2-base-code 和 OpenCoder-1.5B-Base。 所有 15 种嵌入模型与因果语言模型组合的结果均报告在第 4.3 节中。

sents.en: We compare BTTF with the readability baselines in Table 3 under pooled 10-fold cross-validation and leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们在表 3 中，通过合并 10 折交叉验证和“留一数据集”（LODO）评估方法，将 BTTF 与可读性基线模型进行了比较。

sents.zh: 参考配置使用了 jina-embeddings-v2-base-code 和 OpenCoder-1.5B-Base。

sents.en: Results for all 15 combinations of embedding and causal language models are reported in section 4.3 .
sents.zh: 所有 15 种嵌入模型与因果语言模型组合的结果均报告在第 4.3 节中。

paragraphs.en: BTTF provides the most consistent performance across the six datasets, with correlations above 0.53 under both evaluation protocols. Its average correlations are 0.631 under pooled cross-validation and 0.638 under LODO, improving over the strongest baseline average of 0.537 by 0.094 and 0.101, respectively. Individual baselines remain strongest on Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains, but none maintains comparable performance across the complete benchmark pool.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 在六个数据集上表现出最一致的性能，两种评估协议下的相关性均高于 0.53。 在合并交叉验证中，其平均相关性为 0.631；在 LODO 中为 0.638，分别比最强基线模型的平均值 0.537 提升了 0.094 和 0.101。 各个基线模型在 Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains 数据集上仍表现最佳，但没有一个能在整个基准测试池中保持相当的性能。

sents.en: BTTF provides the most consistent performance across the six datasets, with correlations above 0.53 under both evaluation protocols.
sents.zh: BTTF 在六个数据集上表现出最一致的性能，两种评估协议下的相关性均高于 0.53。

sents.en: Its average correlations are 0.631 under pooled cross-validation and 0.638 under LODO, improving over the strongest baseline average of 0.537 by 0.094 and 0.101, respectively.
sents.zh: 在合并交叉验证中，其平均相关性为 0.631；在 LODO 中为 0.638，分别比最强基线模型的平均值 0.537 提升了 0.094 和 0.101。

sents.en: Individual baselines remain strongest on Buse, Scalabrino, Dorn, Schnappinger, and JetBrains, but none maintains comparable performance across the complete benchmark pool.
sents.zh: 各个基线模型在 Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger 和 JetBrains 数据集上仍表现最佳，但没有一个能在整个基准测试池中保持相当的性能。

paragraphs.en: The direct-LLM results improve with GPT-6.1 Sol, which obtains the strongest individual results on Schnappinger and JetBrains. Its average remains 0.537, however, with correlations ranging from 0.206 on Buse to 0.759 on MBJP. These results show that strong agreement with one set of readability judgements does not necessarily transfer to other annotation protocols and code granularities.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 后，直接 LLM 的结果有所提升，它在 Schnappinger 和 JetBrains 测试中取得了最强的个体结果。 然而，其平均值仍为 0.537，相关系数则在 Buse 的 0.206 到 MBJP 的 0.759 之间波动。 这些结果表明，与一组可读性判断的高度一致，并不必然能迁移到其他标注协议和代码粒度上。

sents.en: The direct-LLM results improve with GPT-6.1 Sol, which obtains the strongest individual results on Schnappinger and JetBrains.
sents.zh: 使用 GPT-6.1 Sol 后，直接 LLM 的结果有所提升，它在 Schnappinger 和 JetBrains 测试中取得了最强的个体结果。

sents.en: Its average remains 0.537, however, with correlations ranging from 0.206 on Buse to 0.759 on MBJP.
sents.zh: 然而，其平均值仍为 0.537，相关系数则在 Buse 的 0.206 到 MBJP 的 0.759 之间波动。

sents.en: These results show that strong agreement with one set of readability judgements does not necessarily transfer to other annotation protocols and code granularities.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，与一组可读性判断的高度一致，并不必然能迁移到其他标注协议和代码粒度上。

paragraphs.en: Excluding the target dataset from Ridge training does not reduce overall performance: the LODO average is slightly higher than the pooled result, and the lowest dataset-specific correlation increases from 0.531 to 0.540. Although feature selection uses all six development datasets, each LODO predictor is fitted entirely without samples from its target dataset. Its performance therefore shows that the selected representation transfers across datasets without target-dataset fitting or calibration of the predictor. Dataset-stratified bootstrap confidence intervals are reported in Section G.2 . The pooled and LODO lower bounds are 0.561 and 0.573, respectively, both exceeding the strongest baseline average point estimate of 0.537.
paragraphs.zh: 将目标数据集排除在 Ridge 训练之外并不会降低整体性能：LODO 平均值略高于合并结果，且最低的数据集特定相关性从 0.531 提升至 0.540。 尽管特征选择使用了全部六个开发数据集，但每个 LODO 预测器都是在完全不使用其目标数据集样本的情况下进行拟合的。 因此，其性能表明所选表示能够跨数据集迁移，而无需对预测器进行目标数据集的拟合或校准。 按数据集分层划分的自助置信区间在 G.2 节中报告。 合并结果和 LODO 的下限分别为 0.561 和 0.573，均超过了最强基线方法的平均点估计值 0.537。

sents.en: Excluding the target dataset from Ridge training does not reduce overall performance: the LODO average is slightly higher than the pooled result, and the lowest dataset-specific correlation increases from 0.531 to 0.540.
sents.zh: 将目标数据集排除在 Ridge 训练之外并不会降低整体性能：LODO 平均值略高于合并结果，且最低的数据集特定相关性从 0.531 提升至 0.540。

sents.en: Although feature selection uses all six development datasets, each LODO predictor is fitted entirely without samples from its target dataset.
sents.zh: 尽管特征选择使用了全部六个开发数据集，但每个 LODO 预测器都是在完全不使用其目标数据集样本的情况下进行拟合的。

sents.en: Its performance therefore shows that the selected representation transfers across datasets without target-dataset fitting or calibration of the predictor.
sents.zh: 因此，其性能表明所选表示能够跨数据集迁移，而无需对预测器进行目标数据集的拟合或校准。

sents.en: Dataset-stratified bootstrap confidence intervals are reported in Section G.2 .
sents.zh: 按数据集分层划分的自助置信区间在 G.2 节中报告。

sents.en: The pooled and LODO lower bounds are 0.561 and 0.573, respectively, both exceeding the strongest baseline average point estimate of 0.537.
sents.zh: 合并结果和 LODO 的下限分别为 0.561 和 0.573，均超过了最强基线方法的平均点估计值 0.537。

paragraphs.en: To quantify sampling uncertainty over this fixed six-dataset benchmark suite, we use a paired, dataset-stratified bootstrap ( Efron, 1979 ) . Each replicate resamples the same observations for both methods within each dataset, recomputes Spearman correlation, and equally averages the six dataset-level differences to obtain suite-level intervals and tests.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化这一固定六数据集基准套件上的采样不确定性，我们使用了一种配对且按数据集分层的重抽样方法（Efron, 1979）。 每次重复都会在每个数据集内对两种方法重新采样相同的观测值，重新计算斯皮尔曼相关系数，并等权平均六个数据集层面的差异，以获得套件层面的置信区间和检验结果。

sents.en: To quantify sampling uncertainty over this fixed six-dataset benchmark suite, we use a paired, dataset-stratified bootstrap ( Efron, 1979 ) .
sents.zh: 为了量化这一固定六数据集基准套件上的采样不确定性，我们使用了一种配对且按数据集分层的重抽样方法（Efron, 1979）。

sents.en: Each replicate resamples the same observations for both methods within each dataset, recomputes Spearman correlation, and equally averages the six dataset-level differences to obtain suite-level intervals and tests.
sents.zh: 每次重复都会在每个数据集内对两种方法重新采样相同的观测值，重新计算斯皮尔曼相关系数，并等权平均六个数据集层面的差异，以获得套件层面的置信区间和检验结果。

paragraphs.en: We next examine whether the frozen BTTF assigns lower readability scores to the deliberately degraded Java and Python variants. Response rates by degradation category and language are reported in Table 4 . A successful response occurs when a changed variant receives a lower score than its matched original; the overall rate is calculated over all changed pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将检验冻结的 BTTF 是否对经过故意降级的 Java 和 Python 变体赋予了较低的易读性分数。 按降级类别和语言分类的响应率报告于表 4 中。 当某个修改后的变体获得的分数低于其匹配的原版时，即视为成功响应；总体响应率基于所有修改后的配对计算得出。

sents.en: We next examine whether the frozen BTTF assigns lower readability scores to the deliberately degraded Java and Python variants.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将检验冻结的 BTTF 是否对经过故意降级的 Java 和 Python 变体赋予了较低的易读性分数。

sents.en: Response rates by degradation category and language are reported in Table 4 .
sents.zh: 按降级类别和语言分类的响应率报告于表 4 中。

sents.en: A successful response occurs when a changed variant receives a lower score than its matched original; the overall rate is calculated over all changed pairs.
sents.zh: 当某个修改后的变体获得的分数低于其匹配的原版时，即视为成功响应；总体响应率基于所有修改后的配对计算得出。

paragraphs.en: Scalabrino is omitted from the Python experiment because its released implementation supports Java only. It produced finite predictions for 97 of the 100 Java groups. The reconstructed Dorn extractor processed 99 of the 100 Python groups. Percentages for these methods are calculated over their available changed pairs.
paragraphs.zh: Scalabrino 未被纳入 Python 实验，因为其已发布的实现仅支持 Java。 它对 100 个 Java 组中的 97 个组生成了有限预测。 重构的 Dorn 提取器处理了 100 个 Python 组中的 99 个组。 这些方法的百分比是根据其可用的已更改对计算得出的。

paragraphs.en: BTTF assigns lower readability to 93.8% of changed Java variants and 87.6% of changed Python variants. GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 95.5% in Java and 92.7% in Python. DeepSeek and BTTF both exceed 50% on every transformation in both languages. Dorn remains strongest for Java data-flow changes, while GPT-6.1 Sol is strongest for Python control-flow lowering.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 对 93.8% 的已修改 Java 变体和 87.6% 的已修改 Python 变体赋予了较低的易读性评分。 GPT-6.1 Sol 在 Java 中的准确率达到 95.5%，在 Python 中为 92.7%。 DeepSeek 和 BTTF 在这两种语言的所有转换任务中的准确率均超过了 50%。 Dorn 在处理 Java 数据流变更时表现最强，而 GPT-6.1 Sol 则在降低 Python 控制流复杂度方面表现最佳。

sents.zh: BTTF 对 93.8% 的已修改 Java 变体和 87.6% 的已修改 Python 变体赋予了较低的易读性评分。

sents.en: GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 95.5% in Java and 92.7% in Python.
sents.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 在 Java 中的准确率达到 95.5%，在 Python 中为 92.7%。

sents.en: DeepSeek and BTTF both exceed 50% on every transformation in both languages.

paragraphs.en: For each language, inference is clustered by the 100 original source classes, preserving the dependence among variants derived from the same class ( Field and Welsh, 2007 ) . We report paired cluster-bootstrap intervals, and Holm-adjusted tests across the 13 transformations ( Holm, 1979 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每种语言，推理都按照 100 个原始源类进行聚类，从而保留源自同一类别的不同变体之间的依赖关系（Field 和 Welsh，2007）。 我们报告了成对的集群自助区间，以及对 13 种变换进行的 Holm 调整检验（Holm，1979）。

sents.en: For each language, inference is clustered by the 100 original source classes, preserving the dependence among variants derived from the same class ( Field and Welsh, 2007 ) .
sents.zh: 对于每种语言，推理都按照 100 个原始源类进行聚类，从而保留源自同一类别的不同变体之间的依赖关系（Field 和 Welsh，2007）。

sents.en: We report paired cluster-bootstrap intervals, and Holm-adjusted tests across the 13 transformations ( Holm, 1979 ) .
sents.zh: 我们报告了成对的集群自助区间，以及对 13 种变换进行的 Holm 调整检验（Holm，1979）。

paragraphs.en: At the individual-transformation level, both BTTF and DeepSeek assign lower readability to a majority of changed variants for all 13 transformations in both languages. BTTF’s clearest advantage appears for integer-literal encoding: it responds correctly to 94.7% of Java variants and 100.0% of Python variants, compared with 60.5% and 73.3% for the strongest baseline in each language. It also leads or ties in both languages on comment removal and remains highly responsive to both forms of unrelated-code injection. Complete per-transformation results are reported in Section E.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在个体转换层面，BTTF 和 DeepSeek 对两种语言中全部 13 种转换的大多数变化变体都赋予了较低的易读性评分。 BTTF 最明显的优势体现在整数字面量编码上：它能正确响应 94.7% 的 Java 变体和 100.0% 的 Python 变体，而每种语言中最强的基线模型对此的响应率分别为 60.5% 和 73.3%。 在两种语言中，它在评论移除任务上也处于领先或并列位置，并且对两种形式的不相关代码注入仍能保持高度响应性。 每种转换的完整结果报告见第 E.4 节。

sents.zh: 在个体转换层面，BTTF 和 DeepSeek 对两种语言中全部 13 种转换的大多数变化变体都赋予了较低的易读性评分。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate BTTF under all 15 pairings of five embedding models and three causal code language models. We examine whether its predictive performance and feature-level interpretations remain consistent across these independently fitted instantiations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种嵌入模型与三种因果代码语言模型的全部 15 种组合下对 BTTF 进行了评估。 我们检验了其预测性能与特征层面的解释结果在这些独立训练的实例中是否保持一致。

sents.en: We evaluate BTTF under all 15 pairings of five embedding models and three causal code language models.
sents.zh: 我们在五种嵌入模型与三种因果代码语言模型的全部 15 种组合下对 BTTF 进行了评估。

sents.en: We examine whether its predictive performance and feature-level interpretations remain consistent across these independently fitted instantiations.
sents.zh: 我们检验了其预测性能与特征层面的解释结果在这些独立训练的实例中是否保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The performance range produced by the five embedding choices for each causal language model is summarised in Table 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 五种嵌入方法为每个因果语言模型产生的性能范围汇总于表 5 中。

paragraphs.en: Performance varies only modestly across pretrained-model choices. Across all 15 combinations, the pooled average ranges from 0.613 to 0.633 and the LODO average from 0.617 to 0.638. Java response rates remain within 93.6–95.8%, while Python response rates range from 79.7% to 88.0%. The resulting model therefore retains comparable benchmark and controlled-interference performance when either pretrained component is changed.
paragraphs.zh: 不同预训练模型的选择所带来的性能差异仅属轻微。 在所有 15 种组合中，合并后的平均值介于 0.613 至 0.633 之间，LODO 平均值则介于 0.617 至 0.638 之间。 Java 的响应率保持在 93.6%–95.8% 范围内，而 Python 的响应率则在 79.7% 至 88.0% 之间。 因此，无论更换哪个预训练组件，所得模型都能保持相当水平的基准测试性能和受控干扰性能。

sents.zh: 不同预训练模型的选择所带来的性能差异仅属轻微。

sents.en: Across all 15 combinations, the pooled average ranges from 0.613 to 0.633 and the LODO average from 0.617 to 0.638.

paragraphs.en: We next test whether changing either pretrained component changes the model’s explanation of readability. We compare the sign and magnitude of every standardised Ridge coefficient across all 15 causal-LM–embedding-model pairings in Table 6 . Each pairing is fitted independently, and no coefficient-sign constraints are imposed.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们测试改变任一预训练组件是否会影响模型对可读性的解释。 我们比较了表 6 中所有 15 种因果-LM-嵌入模型配对中每个标准化 Ridge 系数的符号和大小。 每种配对都是独立拟合的，且未施加任何系数符号的约束。

sents.en: We next test whether changing either pretrained component changes the model’s explanation of readability.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们测试改变任一预训练组件是否会影响模型对可读性的解释。

sents.en: We compare the sign and magnitude of every standardised Ridge coefficient across all 15 causal-LM–embedding-model pairings in Table 6 .
sents.zh: 我们比较了表 6 中所有 15 种因果-LM-嵌入模型配对中每个标准化 Ridge 系数的符号和大小。

sents.zh: 每种配对都是独立拟合的，且未施加任何系数符号的约束。

paragraphs.en: Every coefficient range lies entirely below zero, giving 100% direction agreement across the 11 × 15 = 165 11\times 15=165 independently fitted coefficients. The variation is also limited in absolute terms: all spans are below 0.019 on the standardised coefficient scale, and 10 of the 11 are below 0.011. Changing either pretrained component therefore preserves the coefficient directions while keeping their values within a limited absolute range.
paragraphs.zh: 每个系数范围都完全位于零以下，因此在这 11 × 15 = 165 个独立拟合的系数中，方向一致性达到了 100%。 这种变化在绝对值上也很有限：在标准化系数尺度上，所有跨度都低于 0.019，其中 11 个中的 10 个甚至低于 0.011。 因此，改变任意一个预训练组件都能保持系数的方向不变，同时使它们的值限制在一个有限的绝对范围内。

paragraphs.en: This cross-model stability is accompanied by agreement across three levels of analysis. For every retained feature, the theoretically expected relationship with readability, the coefficient obtained when the feature is fitted as the sole predictor, and the coefficient in the complete multivariate model all have the same direction. The learned interpretations are therefore consistent both across pretrained-model choices and between isolated and joint feature analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 这种跨模型稳定性伴随着三个分析层面上的结果一致性。 对于每个保留的特征，其理论上与可读性预期的关系、将该特征作为唯一预测变量时获得的系数，以及完整多变量模型中的系数，都具有相同的方向性。 因此，所学习到的解释既在不同预训练模型的选择之间保持一致，也在一对一特征分析与联合特征分析之间保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The cloud LLMs approach BTTF on controlled transformations, but these comparisons favour direct prompting: garbled names, injected code, and compacted layout make the less-readable variant obvious. Human-rated benchmarks instead require ranking subtler differences among unmodified programs, where the LLMs are substantially less reliable. Buse/66 illustrates both this performance gap and the limits of generated explanations. Rated by 121 participants, the three-statement snippet has a mean human score of 2.603/5 and lies at the 0.152 readability percentile among the 100 Buse snippets:
paragraphs.zh: 云端 LLM 在受控转换方面接近 BTTF，但这些比较更倾向于直接提示：混乱的名称、注入的代码和紧凑的布局使得可读性较差的版本显而易见。 而由人类评分的基准测试则需要对未修改程序之间更细微的差异进行排序，在这些情况下，LLM 的可靠性要低得多。 Buse/66 既展示了这种性能差距，也揭示了生成式解释的局限性。 在 121 名参与者的评分中，这个三语句代码片段的人类平均得分为 2.603/5，在 100 个 Buse 代码片段中处于第 0.152 的可读性百分位：

paragraphs.en: BTTF attributes its low score primarily to operator density ( − 0.264 -0.264 ), literal-tail surprisal ( − 0.118 -0.118 ), identifier-onset surprisal ( − 0.055 -0.055 ), assignment-value surprisal ( − 0.051 -0.051 ), and longest-line length ( − 0.018 -0.018 ). These penalties identify the dense calls, unusual literals, newly introduced names, assignment values, and 116-character final line, while their magnitudes distinguish the relative severity of these problems. In contrast, both direct LLMs substantially overrate the snippet. DeepSeek calls it generally clean, while GPT-6.1 identifies the short name p , numeric indices, unexplained Boolean arguments, and the long final call, yet still assigns 18/20. Across the two responses, the LLMs identify only a subset of the problems captured by BTTF and fail to reflect either their individual severity or their combined effect in scores of 17–18/20. The complete responses are reported in Section D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 的低分主要归因于操作符密度（−0.264）、字面尾部意外性（−0.118）、标识符开头意外性（−0.055）、赋值值意外性（−0.051）以及最长行长度（−0.018）。 这些扣分项指出了密集调用的代码、不寻常的字面量、新引入的名称、赋值值以及包含 116 个字符的最终行，而它们的数值大小则反映了这些问题相对严重的程度。 相比之下，两款直接 LLM 都对该代码片段给出了明显过高的评价。 DeepSeek 认为该代码整体较为干净，而 GPT-6.1 则指出了短名称 p、数字索引、未解释的布尔参数以及较长的最终调用，但仍给出了 18/20 的评分。 综合这两项回应来看，LLM 仅识别出了 BTTF 所捕捉到的一部分问题，且未能通过 17–18/20 的评分反映出这些问题各自的严重程度或它们共同产生的影响。 完整的回应内容见 D.3 节。

paragraphs.en: Existing feature-based models tie their predictions directly to measured features, but suffer from other flaws: Dorn and Scalabrino ( Dorn, 2012 ; Scalabrino et al., 2018 ) feature weights flip sign relative to their domain definitions, while Posnett ( Posnett et al., 2011 ) relies on just three program-level metrics that yield only coarse explanations. Crucially, all 11 features remain directionally consistent—their isolated effects align with their multivariate fitted weights—ensuring that penalties consistently reflect readability deficits. Across both examples, BTTF identifies dense calls, unusual literals, and new names in Buse/66 ; in Figure 1 , assignment-value and literal-tail surprisal pinpoint the unusual assignment and encoded string.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的基于特征模型将预测直接绑定到已测量的特征上，但也存在其他缺陷：Dorn和Scalabrino（Dorn, 2012；Scalabrino等, 2018）的特征权重与其领域定义相比符号相反，而Posnett（Posnett等, 2011）仅依赖三个程序级指标，只能提供粗略的解释。 关键在于，所有11个特征的方向性保持一致——它们的孤立效应与多变量拟合权重相符——从而确保惩罚项始终能反映可读性缺陷。 在这两个例子中，BTTF都识别出了Buse/66中的密集调用、异常字面量和新名称；在图1中，赋值-值对和字面量尾部带来的意外性凸显了异常的赋值和编码字符串。

sents.en: Across both examples, BTTF identifies dense calls, unusual literals, and new names in Buse/66 ; in Figure 1 , assignment-value and literal-tail surprisal pinpoint the unusual assignment and encoded string.
sents.zh: 在这两个例子中，BTTF都识别出了Buse/66中的密集调用、异常字面量和新名称；在图1中，赋值-值对和字面量尾部带来的意外性凸显了异常的赋值和编码字符串。

paragraphs.en: We ablate each of the three feature families from the fixed final representation without repeating feature selection. After removing a family, the remaining features are refitted using the same Ridge hyperparameters, datasets, target transformations, and fold assignments. We additionally compare BTTF with the independently selected 18-feature embedding-only predecessor.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从固定的最终表示中移除三个特征族中的每一个，且不会重复进行特征选择。 移除一个特征族后，使用相同的 Ridge 超参数、数据集、目标转换和折分配对剩余特征进行重新拟合。 我们还进一步将 BTTF 与先前独立选择的仅包含 18 个特征的嵌入模型进行了比较。

sents.zh: 我们从固定的最终表示中移除三个特征族中的每一个，且不会重复进行特征选择。

sents.zh: 我们还进一步将 BTTF 与先前独立选择的仅包含 18 个特征的嵌入模型进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: All three families contribute to agreement with human judgements. Removing the traditional features produces the largest benchmark loss, reducing the pooled and LODO averages by 0.176 and 0.163. Removing the causal-LM features reduces them by 0.090 and 0.093 and produces the largest behavioural loss: the Java and Python response rates fall by 20.2% and 14.7%. Removing the embedding-derived features has a smaller effect on the human-rated benchmarks, reducing the pooled and LODO averages by 0.045 and 0.042, respectively. Its Python response decreases slightly, whereas its Java response increases by 1.5%.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个特征集都有助于模型与人类判断的一致性。 移除传统特征会导致基准测试损失最大，使合并平均值和 LODO 平均值分别下降 0.176 和 0.163。 移除因果语言模型特征会使这两个平均值分别下降 0.090 和 0.093，并导致最大的行为损失：Java 和 Python 的响应率分别下降了 20.2% 和 14.7%。 移除嵌入衍生特征对人类评分的基准测试影响较小，仅使合并平均值和 LODO 平均值分别下降 0.045 和 0.042。 其 Python 响应率略有下降，而 Java 响应率则上升了 1.5%。

paragraphs.en: The independently selected predecessor provides a complementary comparison with the complete representation available before causal-LM features were introduced. BTTF improves its pooled and LODO averages by 0.080 and 0.090 and its Java and Python responses by 7.0% and 11.4%, while using seven fewer features. The complete pretrained-model comparison in Appendix G shows that these gains are not tied to the selected reference pairing.
paragraphs.zh: 独立选择的先前模型为在引入因果-LM 特征之前可用的完整表示提供了补充性比较。 BTTF 将其合并和 LODO 平均值分别提升了 0.080 和 0.090，其 Java 和 Python 响应分别提升了 7.0% 和 11.4%，同时使用的特征减少了七个。 附录 G 中完整的预训练模型比较表明，这些增益并不依赖于所选的参考配对。

sents.zh: 独立选择的先前模型为在引入因果-LM 特征之前可用的完整表示提供了补充性比较。

paragraphs.en: Full results for the independently selected embedding-only predecessor are reported in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 独立选择的仅嵌入前驱的完整结果报告于附录 F。

paragraphs.en: The six datasets measure readability using different rating scales, human-rating procedures, and kinds of source units, so their raw scores are not directly comparable. We convert scores to percentile ranks within each dataset and give every dataset equal total weight. This preserves the ordering of human judgements within each dataset while preventing a particular scale or larger dataset from dominating BTTF’s fit, allowing it to identify readability signals that recur across independently collected annotation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 这六个数据集使用不同的评分量表、人类评分流程以及不同类型的源单元来衡量可读性，因此它们的原始分数无法直接比较。 我们将每个数据集的分数转换为百分位排名，并赋予每个数据集相等的总权重。 这样既保留了每个数据集中人类判断的顺序，又防止了某种特定的量表或规模更大的数据集主导 BTTF 的拟合，从而使其能够识别出在不同独立收集的标注设置中重复出现的可读性信号。

sents.zh: 这六个数据集使用不同的评分量表、人类评分流程以及不同类型的源单元来衡量可读性，因此它们的原始分数无法直接比较。

paragraphs.en: The human-rated literature is concentrated on Java. This is not a consequence of selective dataset choice: four of the five public benchmarks are Java-only, and the fifth includes Java alongside Python and CUDA. To test beyond this evidence base, we conduct a separate experiment on Python production code, where BTTF responds in the expected direction to 87.6% of changed variants and responds to a majority of variants for every transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 人类评估的文献主要集中在 Java 上。 这并非由于数据集的选择性所致：五个公开基准测试中有四个仅包含 Java，而第五个则同时包含 Java、Python 和 CUDA。 为了超越这一证据基础进行测试，我们对 Python 生产代码进行了一项独立实验，其中 BTTF 对 87.6% 的变更变体做出了预期方向的响应，并且对每种转换的大多数变体都做出了响应。

sents.zh: 人类评估的文献主要集中在 Java 上。

paragraphs.en: The final feature set and its size were selected using all six human-rated datasets. Pooled cross-validation and LODO consequently evaluate prediction with this fixed representation, not the transfer of the complete selection procedure to a future benchmark. We therefore also test the frozen BTTF across 13 controlled transformations in separately constructed Java and Python corpora excluded from both feature selection and predictor training.
paragraphs.zh: 最终的特征集及其规模是借助全部六个由人类标注的数据集选定的。 因此，合并交叉验证和 LODO 评估的是基于这种固定表示的预测效果，而非将整个选择过程迁移到未来的基准测试中。 因此，我们还在分别构建的 Java 和 Python 语料库中，通过 13 种受控变换来测试冻结的 BTTF；这些语料库既未用于特征选择，也未用于预测器训练。

sents.zh: 最终的特征集及其规模是借助全部六个由人类标注的数据集选定的。

paragraphs.en: We now examine the feature engineering behind BTTF: how its three feature families complement one another, how pretrained models provide interpretable measurements, and what the selection results reveal about the available supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在来研究 BTTF 背后的特征工程：其三个特征族如何相互补充，预训练模型如何提供可解释的度量，以及选择结果揭示了哪些关于可用监督的信息。

paragraphs.en: The results support a view of readability as the joint effect of three properties: the explicit complexity presented by the source, the semantic organisation of its program elements, and the extent to which those elements conform to the context established during reading. The feature family ablation shows that these properties are complementary rather than interchangeable. Traditional measurements provide the strongest foundation for agreement with human ratings, causal-LM measurements contribute both benchmark performance and sensitivity to controlled degradation, and embedding-derived measurements add information about organisation that is not fully expressed by either other family alone. One small exception is the 1.5-point increase in the Java interference response after removing embedding features. Some controlled rewrites reduce structural-pattern count or identifier-space dispersion even as they reduce readability, creating a local mismatch between embedding compactness and readability.
paragraphs.zh: 研究结果支持这样一种观点：可读性是三个属性共同作用的结果，即源文本所呈现的显式复杂性、其程序元素的语义组织，以及这些元素在多大程度上符合阅读过程中建立的上下文。 特征族消融分析表明，这些属性是互补的，而非可相互替换的。 传统测量方法为与人类评分的一致性提供了最坚实的基础，因果-LM 测量既贡献了基准性能，也增强了对受控退化的敏感性，而嵌入衍生测量则补充了关于组织结构的额外信息，这些信息是其他任一特征族单独无法完全表达的。 一个较小的例外是，在移除嵌入特征后，Java 干扰响应出现了 1.5 分的上升。 某些受控重写虽然降低了可读性，但也减少了结构模式的数量或标识符空间的离散度，从而在嵌入紧凑性与可读性之间造成了局部不匹配。
