paragraphs.en: The change from the embedding-only model to BTTF illustrates how causal-LM features replace an indirect traditional proxy. Source-text byte entropy ranked second in the five-embedding consensus, but fell to 39th after the causal-LM measurements were introduced. Byte entropy captures the overall irregularity of source text, but cannot show which program element is difficult to anticipate or whether earlier code helps explain it. The selected construct-level surprisal features instead localise unexpected information to literals, identifier onsets, assignment values, declarations, and short identifiers while quantifying how much preceding context explains it.
paragraphs.zh: 从仅使用嵌入模型到 BTTF 的转变表明，因果语言模型的特征如何取代了传统的间接代理变量。 在五种嵌入方法的共识结果中，源文本的字节熵值排名第二，但在引入因果语言模型测量后，其排名降至第 39 位。 字节熵能够捕捉源文本的整体不规则性，但无法显示具体哪个程序元素难以预测，也无法说明早期代码是否有助于解释该元素。 相反，所选的构建层意外性特征能够将意外信息定位到字面量、标识符开头、赋值值、声明和短标识符，同时量化先前上下文在多大程度上能够解释这些信息。

paragraphs.en: Direct prompting provides a useful contrast to our use of pretrained models for feature construction. Newer models improve substantially over earlier prompt-based results: GPT-6.1 Sol reaches an average correlation of 0.537 and is strongest on Schnappinger and JetBrains. Its correlations nevertheless range from 0.206 to 0.759 across the six benchmarks and remain below BTTF’s average of 0.631. A generated score also does not reveal which properties of the source shaped the judgement.
paragraphs.zh: 直接提示为我们使用预训练模型进行特征构建的方式提供了一个有益的对比。 较新的模型在基于提示的早期结果基础上有了显著提升：GPT-6.1 Sol 的平均相关性达到了 0.537，并在 Schnappinger 和 JetBrains 上的表现最为出色。 然而，它在六个基准测试中的相关性范围从 0.206 到 0.759，仍然低于 BTTF 的 0.631 平均值。 生成的分数也无法揭示源数据的哪些属性影响了最终的判断。

sents.zh: 直接提示为我们使用预训练模型进行特征构建的方式提供了一个有益的对比。

paragraphs.en: The two direct-prompting baselines average 1,083 prompt tokens and 1,245 total tokens per evaluation. BTTF instead computes its embedding and surprisal features using compact local models, without remote prompting or response generation.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种直接提示基准模型在每次评估中平均消耗 1,083 个提示词元和 1,245 个总词元。 而 BTTF 则使用紧凑的本地模型计算其嵌入和意外度特征，无需远程提示或响应生成。

sents.en: The two direct-prompting baselines average 1,083 prompt tokens and 1,245 total tokens per evaluation.
sents.zh: 这两种直接提示基准模型在每次评估中平均消耗 1,083 个提示词元和 1,245 个总词元。

sents.en: BTTF instead computes its embedding and surprisal features using compact local models, without remote prompting or response generation.
sents.zh: 而 BTTF 则使用紧凑的本地模型计算其嵌入和意外度特征，无需远程提示或响应生成。

paragraphs.en: Compared with end-to-end neural predictors and earlier feature-based models, BTTF’s representation follows an information-theoretic view of code comprehension. Each selected feature describes a recognisable source of reading difficulty, such as dense operations, fragmented structural patterns, unexpected identifiers, or values that are difficult to anticipate from preceding code. For every feature, its expected relationship with readability, its association when used alone, and its coefficient in BTTF’s complete fit have the same direction. This three-way agreement connects each interpretation to both the feature definition and the empirical evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 与端到端神经预测器和早期的基于特征模型相比，BTTF 的表示遵循一种基于信息论的代码理解视角。 每个选定的特征都描述了一种可识别的阅读困难来源，例如密集的操作、碎片化的结构模式、意外的标识符，或难以根据前文代码预测的值。 对于每个特征，其与可读性的预期关系、单独使用时的相关性，以及其在 BTTF 完整拟合中的系数都具有相同的方向性。 这种三重一致性将每种解释都与特征定义和实证证据联系起来。

sents.zh: 这种三重一致性将每种解释都与特征定义和实证证据联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Among the evaluated readability models, Posnett is the only one that is both more compact than BTTF and fully consistent between feature meaning and coefficient direction. Its three features provide useful but broad summaries, whereas our 11 features identify construct-specific sources of reading difficulty and achieve substantially stronger agreement with human ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 在已评估的可读性模型中，Posnett 是唯一一个既比 BTTF 更简洁，又在特征含义与系数方向上完全一致的模型。 它的三个特征虽然能提供有用但较为宽泛的总结，而我们的 11 个特征则能识别出特定构念的阅读困难来源，并实现了与人类评分显著更强的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Some readability properties do not appear in BTTF, possibly because the available human ratings do not capture them consistently. Comments provide the clearest example: among 12 candidates covering comment presence, comment–identifier alignment, comment–code relevance, and predictive value, the highest-ranked is only 44th in the 15-model consensus.

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, BTTF responds strongly to comment removal: deleting comment-only lines raises operator and decision density, while losing preceding comment context can change the predictability of later program elements. The retained features therefore capture part of the information supplied by comments without a dedicated comment feature.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，BTTF 对评论的删除反应强烈：仅删除评论行会提高操作符和决策密度，而失去前面的评论上下文则可能改变后续程序元素的可预测性。 因此，保留的特征在没有专门评论特征的情况下，仍然捕捉到了部分由评论提供的信息。

paragraphs.en: In this work, code readability refers to how easily developers can read and understand a source-code sample, as reflected in human judgements ( Buse and Weimer, 2009 ; Dorn, 2012 ; Sergeyuk et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，代码可读性指的是开发者阅读和理解源代码样本的难易程度，这一点体现在人类的判断中（Buse and Weimer, 2009；Dorn, 2012；Sergeyuk et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Early automated approaches relied on structural complexity measures such as Cyclomatic Complexity ( McCabe, 1976 ) and Halstead metrics ( Halstead, 1977 ) . Although useful for describing program structure, such metrics provide only indirect proxies for human-perceived readability and understandability ( Lavazza et al., 2023b ) . However, Halstead metrics rest on disputed theoretical assumptions, derive some apparent relationships from their own mathematical definitions, and lack consistent empirical support ( Lassez et al., 1981 ; Shen et al., 1983 ; Card and Agresti, 1987 ) . Cyclomatic Complexity reduces complexity to control-flow decisions without a convincing link to broader software difficulty, and is strongly confounded with lines of code, which often performs as well or better ( Shepperd, 1988 ; Shepperd and Ince, 1994 ) . Similarly, rule-based heuristics like Cognitive Complexity sum arbitrary syntactic penalties while ignoring identifier semantics, layout, and visual structure, failing basic tests of construct validity and formal metric properties ( Lavazza et al., 2023a ) . Moreover, readability improvements made by developers are not always captured by automated static-analysis tools ( Dantas et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的自动化方法依赖于结构性复杂度度量指标，例如循环复杂度（McCabe，1976）和Halstead度量（Halstead，1977）。 尽管这些指标有助于描述程序结构，但它们只能间接反映人类感知到的可读性和可理解性（Lavazza等，2023b）。 然而，Halstead度量建立在存在争议的理论假设之上，其部分表面关系源于自身的数学定义，且缺乏一致的实证支持（Lassez等，1981；Shen等，1983；Card和Agresti，1987）。 循环复杂度将复杂度简化为控制流决策，但未能与更广泛的软件难度建立令人信服的联系，并且它与代码行数量存在强烈的混淆关系，而后者通常表现同样良好甚至更优（Shepperd，1988；Shepperd和Ince，1994）。 类似地，认知复杂度等基于规则的启发式方法会累加任意的语法惩罚项，却忽略了标识符的语义、布局和视觉结构，因此未能通过构造效度和正式度量属性等基本检验（Lavazza等，2023a）。 此外，开发者所做的可读性改进并不总能被自动化的静态分析工具捕捉到（Dantas等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: In parallel, empirical software engineering researchers formulated readability prediction as a supervised learning problem. Buse and Weimer ( Buse and Weimer, 2009 ) combined structural, lexical, syntactic, and layout features to predict human readability judgements. Posnett et al. ( Posnett et al., 2011 ) showed that a substantially smaller model based on lines of code, Halstead volume, and entropy could achieve competitive performance. Scalabrino et al. ( Scalabrino et al., 2018 ) later incorporated richer textual properties, including identifier and comment information, while Mi et al. ( Mi et al., 2018 ; Mi et al., 2022 ) explored neural models that reduce dependence on manually designed features. Across these approaches, models fit formulas to disputed structural metrics, learn feature effects that conflict with their stated meanings, or rely on opaque neural representations. They also remain imperfectly aligned with human judgements and may fail to reflect readability improvements perceived by developers ( Pantiuchina et al., 2018 ; Sergeyuk et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，经验性软件工程研究人员将可读性预测构建为一个监督学习问题。 Buse 和 Weimer（Buse and Weimer, 2009）结合了结构、词汇、句法和布局特征来预测人类对可读性的判断。Posnett 等人 （Posnett et al., 2011）表明，一个基于代码行数、Halstead 体积和熵的规模小得多的模型也能达到具有竞争力的性能。Scalabrino 等人 （Scalabrino et al., 2018）后来纳入了更丰富的文本属性，包括标识符和注释信息，而 Mi 等人 （Mi et al., 2018; Mi et al., 2022）则探索了能够减少对人工设计特征依赖的神经模型。 在这些方法中，模型要么将公式拟合到存在争议的结构指标上，要么学习与其声明含义相冲突的特征影响，要么依赖不透明的神经表示。 此外，这些方法与人类判断仍存在不完全一致之处，并且可能无法反映开发者所感知到的可读性提升（Pantiuchina et al., 2018; Sergeyuk et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has investigated language models as an alternative source of readability signals. Surprisal, defined as the negative log-probability of an observed item given its preceding context, has a long-standing connection to expectation-based theories of incremental language-processing difficulty ( Levy, 2008 ) . This connection makes language-model probability a plausible source of readability information, but evidence from complete texts shows that a single aggregate is not sufficient. For natural-language sentences, Miaschi et al. ( Miaschi et al., 2020 ) find only a weak relationship between neural language-model perplexity and readability, with the two measurements responding to different linguistic phenomena. For source code, Dillmann et al. ( Dillmann et al., 2024 ) evaluate whole-class cross-entropy against expert judgements of readability and related maintainability dimensions. The unadjusted association is contrary to the expected direction and changes after controlling for logical lines of code; they conclude that class-level cross-entropy alone may be insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究已将语言模型视为可读性信号的替代来源。 意外度（Surprisal）定义为在给定上下文的情况下，观察到某项内容的负对数概率，它与基于预期的增量语言处理难度理论长期存在关联（Levy, 2008）。 这种关联使语言模型的概率成为可信的可读性信息来源，但完整文本的证据表明，单一的整体指标并不足够。 对于自然语言句子，Miaschi等人 （Miaschi et al., 2020）发现神经语言模型的困惑度与可读性之间仅有微弱的关系，且这两种测量指标反映的是不同的语言现象。 对于源代码，Dillmann等人 （Dillmann et al., 2024）将整类交叉熵与专家对可读性及相关可维护性维度的判断进行了评估。 未经调整的关联性与预期方向相反，并在控制代码逻辑行数后发生变化；他们得出结论，仅凭类级别的交叉熵可能并不足够。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work uses language models as direct readability evaluators. Ouédraogo et al. ( Ouédraogo et al., 2025 ) compare direct readability judgements across models, languages, and prompting strategies, finding moderate but variable alignment with human ratings.
paragraphs.zh: 另一项研究将语言模型用作直接的易读性评估工具。Ouédraogo 等人 （Ouédraogo 等人，2025）比较了不同模型、语言和提示策略下的直接易读性判断，发现这些判断与人类评分存在中等程度但存在差异的一致性。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of cognitive research explains understanding in terms of compact representations: related observations can be expressed through shared patterns and shorter descriptions ( Chater and Vitányi, 2003 ; Feldman, 2016 ) . Research on program comprehension likewise shows that readers form mental representations at multiple levels of abstraction rather than retain source details independently ( Pennington, 1987 ; Bidlake et al., 2020 ) . This perspective shifts attention from the amount of source information alone to how readily it can be organised into coherent higher-level representations.
paragraphs.zh: 一条互补的认知研究路线从紧凑表示的角度来解释理解：相关观察可以通过共享模式和更简短的描述来表达（Chater 和 Vitányi，2003；Feldman，2016）。 程序理解方面的研究同样表明，读者会在多个抽象层次上形成心理表征，而不是独立地保留源代码的细节（Pennington，1987；Bidlake 等，2020）。 这一视角将注意力从单纯的信息量转移到了这些信息能够多容易地被组织成连贯的高层表征之上。

paragraphs.en: Our work connects this account of semantic organisation with the established readability features and language-model evidence reviewed above. Embeddings measure how source elements organise into related groups, while causal language models locate information that is unexpected in its preceding context. BTTF returns to explicit feature-based prediction, but equips it with pretrained representations used as measurement instruments rather than direct readability judges.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作将这种语义组织描述与上文回顾的已确立的可读性特征和语言模型证据联系起来。 嵌入表示衡量源元素如何组织成相关组别，而因果语言模型则定位那些在其前文语境中出乎意料的信息。 BTTF 回归到基于显式特征的预测方法，但为其配备了预训练表示，这些表示被用作测量工具，而非直接的可读性评判者。

sents.zh: 我们的工作将这种语义组织描述与上文回顾的已确立的可读性特征和语言模型证据联系起来。

paragraphs.en: BTTF shows that code-readability modelling need not trade predictive strength for interpretability. Using pretrained models as measurement instruments rather than end-to-end judges, it achieves state-of-the-art human agreement with stable, interpretable feature directions. This supports developer feedback, readability-aware LLM post-training, and automated code improvement.
paragraphs.zh: BTTF 表明，代码可读性建模不必在预测能力与可解释性之间做出权衡。 通过将预训练模型用作测量工具而非端到端的评判者，该方法实现了与人类判断高度一致的最新成果，同时保持了特征方向的可解释性和稳定性。 这为开发者反馈、注重可读性的 LLM 后训练以及自动化代码改进提供了支持。

sents.en: Using pretrained models as measurement instruments rather than end-to-end judges, it achieves state-of-the-art human agreement with stable, interpretable feature directions.
sents.zh: 通过将预训练模型用作测量工具而非端到端的评判者，该方法实现了与人类判断高度一致的最新成果，同时保持了特征方向的可解释性和稳定性。

sents.en: This supports developer feedback, readability-aware LLM post-training, and automated code improvement.

paragraphs.en: Each extracted snippet records a normalised string, its source-line position, and one of the types listed in Table 8 .

paragraphs.en: The snippet representation is language aware. Complete Java and Python units are processed using their corresponding syntactic representations, while explicitly declared fragments and C-family code use bounded language-specific lexical extraction. Extracted strings are whitespace-normalised and bounded to prevent unusually large constructs from dominating the embedding computation.
paragraphs.zh: 片段表示具有语言感知能力。 完整的 Java 和 Python 单元使用其对应的句法表示进行处理，而明确声明的片段和 C 族代码则使用有界的语言特定词法提取方法。 提取出的字符串会进行空白符归一化处理并设置边界，以防止异常大的结构在嵌入计算中占据主导地位。

paragraphs.en: Each distinct type–string pair is embedded once and retains its source occurrence count as a weight. Transformer outputs are converted to one vector using attention-mask-aware mean pooling. The vectors are subsequently normalised before cosine geometry and clustering features are computed.
paragraphs.zh: 每个独特的类型–字符串对都会被嵌入一次，并保留其源出现次数作为权重。 通过考虑注意力掩码的平均池化方法，将 Transformer 的输出转换为一个向量。 随后对这些向量进行归一化处理，然后计算余弦几何和聚类特征。

paragraphs.en: Comment-related features are divided into two complementary groups. First, three features measure alignment between comments and identifiers using the mean pairwise similarity, maximum pairwise similarity, and similarity between the weighted comment and identifier centroids. Second, four features characterise the relevance of comments to code. For each comment, we compute its maximum cosine similarity to a non-comment semantic snippet. The resulting similarities are summarised by their weighted mean and minimum.
paragraphs.zh: 与评论相关的特征被分为两个互补的组。 首先，三个特征通过成对相似度的均值、最大成对相似度以及加权评论与标识符质心之间的相似度，来衡量评论与标识符之间的一致性。 其次，四个特征描述了评论与代码的相关性。 对于每个评论，我们计算它与非评论语义片段之间的最大余弦相似度。 所得到的相似度通过其加权平均值和最小值进行总结。

sents.en: The resulting similarities are summarised by their weighted mean and minimum.

paragraphs.en: To identify potentially irrelevant comments without using readability labels, each embedding model receives an independently calibrated similarity threshold. Calibration uses 24 fixed code–comment anchors: eight Java, eight Python, and eight JavaScript examples. Each anchor provides one relevant comment and one deterministic mismatched comment borrowed from another anchor in the same language, producing 48 labelled calibration comparisons. The threshold maximises balanced accuracy and is stored with the embedding-model-specific calibration artefact.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不使用可读性标签的情况下识别可能无关的评论，每个嵌入模型都会获得一个独立校准的相似性阈值。 校准过程使用了 24 个固定的代码–评论锚点：8 个 Java 示例、8 个 Python 示例和 8 个 JavaScript 示例。 每个锚点提供一个相关评论和一个确定性的不匹配评论，后者从同一语言中的另一个锚点借用，从而生成 48 组带标签的校准对比。 该阈值能够最大化平衡准确率，并与特定于嵌入模型的校准产物一同存储。

paragraphs.en: The final two comment-relevance features are the source-weighted fraction of comments below this threshold and their mean positive similarity deficit. The calibration corpus is fixed independently of the six readability benchmarks and is not fitted using human readability scores.
paragraphs.zh: 最后两个评论相关性特征分别是低于该阈值的评论的源加权比例，以及它们的平均正向相似性赤字。 校准语料库独立于六个可读性基准而固定，并且不是通过人类可读性评分进行拟合的。

paragraphs.en: Token losses are aligned back to the original source offsets. When a token overlaps only part of a measured region, its surprisal is allocated uniformly across its covered source bytes. Unions of source spans are used for denominators so that overlapping syntactic roles do not count the same byte twice within one measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 标记损失会回对齐到原始源文本的偏移量。 当一个标记仅与某个测量区域的部分内容重叠时，其意外度会均匀分配至其所覆盖的源文本字节上。 源文本跨度的并集被用作分母，这样重叠的句法角色就不会在单次测量中重复计算同一字节两次。

paragraphs.en: The typed-unit spans are extracted from the source syntax rather than from tokenizer strings. Declaration headers exclude bodies and variable initializers; call targets exclude argument expressions; control-flow headers exclude their controlled bodies; and assignment measurements use only the initializer or right-hand-side expression. Literal spans exclude documentation strings. For each role, the mean BPB is weighted by covered bytes, the tail is the mean of the most difficult 20% of occurrences, and the standard deviation measures heterogeneity across occurrences.
paragraphs.zh: 类型单元跨度是从源语法中提取的，而不是从分词器字符串中提取的。 声明头不包含声明体和变量初始化式；调用目标不包含参数表达式；控制流头不包含其受控体；而赋值测量仅使用初始化式或右侧表达式。 字面量跨度不包含文档字符串。 对于每个角色，平均 BPB 按覆盖字节数进行加权，尾部是最难处理的 20% 出现次数的平均值，而标准差则衡量各出现次数之间的异质性。

paragraphs.en: Local-organisation features divide the source trace into consecutive 32-token blocks. They distinguish uniformly difficult code from code in which surprisal is concentrated in a few regions or changes abruptly. The difficult-block run uses the within-source 80th percentile and is normalised by the number of blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 局部组织特征将源轨迹划分为连续的 32 个词元块。 它们能够区分均匀困难的代码与那些意外性集中在少数区域或突然变化的代码。 困难块连续段使用源内第 80 百分位数，并按块数进行归一化。

paragraphs.en: Identifier-reuse features operate on confirmed parameter and local-variable bindings. Identical spellings in different scopes are not merged. The first occurrence of a binding is separated from its later uses, allowing the representation to measure whether a name becomes easier to predict after it has been introduced. First-tokenizer-piece and continuation-piece measurements allocate surprisal back to the bytes belonging to the same identifier, reducing dependence on the number of tokenizer pieces.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符重用特征作用于已确认的参数和局部变量绑定。 不同作用域中拼写相同的标识符不会被合并。 绑定的首次出现与其后续使用被分开，这使得该表示法能够衡量某个名称在引入后是否变得更易于预测。 首个分词单元和延续单元测量方法将意外性重新分配给属于同一标识符的字节，从而减少了对分词单元数量的依赖。

paragraphs.en: For each screened matrix, we independently rank either 181 or 228 eligible candidates using an L1-regularised logistic regression ( Tibshirani, 1996 ) . Readability scores are binarised independently within every dataset at the dataset-specific median: samples with scores greater than or equal to the median are assigned to the higher-readability class. Median ties remain in that class, and no middle-score samples are discarded. This produces a common screening task over all 1,100 human-rated samples while preventing differences in numerical annotation scales from defining the screening labels.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个经过筛选的矩阵，我们使用 L1 正则化逻辑回归（Tibshirani, 1996）独立地对 181 或 228 个符合条件的候选项进行排序。 在每一组数据中，可读性分数都基于该数据集特有的中位数独立地进行二值化处理：分数大于或等于中位数的样本被归入高可读性类别。 中位数相等的样本仍保留在该类别中，且没有任何中间分数的样本被丢弃。 这样便在所有 1,100 个人工评分的样本上形成了一个共同的筛选任务，同时避免了数值标注尺度的差异对筛选标签的定义产生影响。

sents.en: For each screened matrix, we independently rank either 181 or 228 eligible candidates using an L1-regularised logistic regression ( Tibshirani, 1996 ) .
sents.zh: 对于每个经过筛选的矩阵，我们使用 L1 正则化逻辑回归（Tibshirani, 1996）独立地对 181 或 228 个符合条件的候选项进行排序。

sents.en: Readability scores are binarised independently within every dataset at the dataset-specific median: samples with scores greater than or equal to the median are assigned to the higher-readability class.
sents.zh: 在每一组数据中，可读性分数都基于该数据集特有的中位数独立地进行二值化处理：分数大于或等于中位数的样本被归入高可读性类别。

sents.en: Median ties remain in that class, and no middle-score samples are discarded.
sents.zh: 中位数相等的样本仍保留在该类别中，且没有任何中间分数的样本被丢弃。

sents.en: This produces a common screening task over all 1,100 human-rated samples while preventing differences in numerical annotation scales from defining the screening labels.
sents.zh: 这样便在所有 1,100 个人工评分的样本上形成了一个共同的筛选任务，同时避免了数值标注尺度的差异对筛选标签的定义产生影响。

paragraphs.en: Missing feature values are imputed using the median estimated from the corresponding fitting sample, after which the features are standardised. Samples are weighted inversely by the size of their source dataset so that each dataset contributes equal total weight. The logistic regression additionally uses balanced class weights.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失的特征值使用对应拟合样本估算出的中位数进行插补，之后对特征进行标准化处理。 样本的权重与其来源数据集的大小成反比，以确保每个数据集贡献的总权重相等。 逻辑回归还使用了平衡的类别权重。

sents.en: Missing feature values are imputed using the median estimated from the corresponding fitting sample, after which the features are standardised.
sents.zh: 缺失的特征值使用对应拟合样本估算出的中位数进行插补，之后对特征进行标准化处理。

sents.en: Samples are weighted inversely by the size of their source dataset so that each dataset contributes equal total weight.
sents.zh: 样本的权重与其来源数据集的大小成反比，以确保每个数据集贡献的总权重相等。

sents.en: The logistic regression additionally uses balanced class weights.
sents.zh: 逻辑回归还使用了平衡的类别权重。

paragraphs.en: The model uses C = 0.08 C=0.08 , L1 regularisation, the liblinear solver, a maximum of 5,000 iterations, and random seed 42. To reduce sensitivity to sampling variation, we perform 200 stability-selection rounds ( Meinshausen and Bühlmann, 2010 ) . In each round, 70% of the samples from each of the six datasets are selected uniformly without replacement. A new imputer, scaler, and logistic regression model are fitted to the resulting sample.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型使用 C = 0.08、L1 正则化、liblinear 求解器、最多 5,000 次迭代以及随机种子 42。 为了降低对采样变化的敏感性，我们执行了 200 轮稳定性选择（Meinshausen 和 Bühlmann，2010）。 在每一轮中，从六个数据集中每个数据集的 70% 样本以不放回均匀方式被选中。 针对所得到的样本，我们拟合了一个新的缺失值填补器、缩放器和逻辑回归模型。

paragraphs.en: The support count first distinguishes features that are consistently active across pretrained-model pairings. Because many candidates receive nonzero support from all screened matrices, the mean selection frequency provides the principal discrimination within the largest support group. The remaining criteria resolve further ties using coefficient magnitude and consistency across the per-model rankings.

Consequently, cross-model support alone is not sufficient to determine either ordering; selection frequency and the subsequent tie-breaking criteria remain important within the largest support group.

paragraphs.en: The first pass was completed before causal-LM features were introduced. We reviewed the leading consensus-ranked candidates for interpretability, portability, redundancy, sensitivity to extreme observations, and fitted direction. Pairwise redundancy was defined by an absolute Pearson or Spearman correlation above 0.9. The resulting independently selected model contains 18 features; all occur within the first 24 consensus positions and receive nonzero support from all five embedding models. Its cross-embedding performance is reported in Appendix F .
paragraphs.zh: 在引入因果-LM特征之前，第一轮筛选就已经完成。 我们审查了可解释性、可移植性、冗余性、对极端观测值的敏感性以及拟合方向方面表现领先的共识排名候选特征。 成对冗余性通过绝对皮尔逊或斯皮尔曼相关系数高于0.9来定义。 最终独立选出的模型包含18个特征；这些特征全部出现在前24个共识位置内，并且得到了所有五个嵌入模型的非零支持。 其跨嵌入性能报告见附录F。

paragraphs.en: After adding the 47 causal-LM candidates, we rerun all 200 stability rounds for each of the 15 causal-LM–embedding-model pairings and construct a new 228-feature consensus ranking. paragraphs.en: We additionally examine whether separating comments by content yields a more useful comment-predictability signal. Comments are grouped deterministically as descriptive prose, code-like content, licence/provenance metadata, visual separators, mixed content, or unclassified content. For each group, we add its mean comment BPB as a candidate and repeat the same 15-model stability-selection procedure, expanding the candidate pool from 228 to 234 features.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还进一步研究了按内容对评论进行划分是否能产生更有用的评论可预测性信号。 评论被确定性地分为描述性文本、类代码内容、许可/来源元数据、视觉分隔符、混合内容或未分类内容。 对于每个分组，我们将其平均评论 BPB 作为一个候选特征添加进来，并重复相同的 15 模型稳定性选择流程，从而将候选特征池从 228 个扩展到 234 个。

paragraphs.en: None of the six candidates enters the first 11 positions, and the membership of the selected feature set remains unchanged. Separating comments by content therefore does not produce a dedicated comment-predictability feature with sufficient independent support to enter the final representation.

paragraphs.en: The number of votes per JetBrains sample ranges from 11 to 31, with a median of 20. Although the dataset also supports a binary majority-vote label, we retain the vote fraction as a continuous target for the final regression and evaluation tasks so that the degree of annotator agreement is preserved. paragraphs.en: MBJP is a small development dataset constructed specifically for this study. We select programming tasks from the Java portion of MBXP ( Athiwaratkun et al., 2023 ) and use gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 to generate candidate Java solutions. The solutions are generated under two prompting conditions intended to produce contrasting readability characteristics while preserving functional correctness.
paragraphs.zh: MBJP 是一个专门为本研究构建的小型开发数据集。 我们从 MBXP（Athiwaratkun 等人，2023）的 Java 部分中选择编程任务，并使用 gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 生成候选的 Java 解决方案。 这些解决方案是在两种提示条件下生成的，旨在在保持功能正确性的同时产生对比鲜明的可读性特征。

sents.en: MBJP is a small development dataset constructed specifically for this study.
sents.zh: MBJP 是一个专门为本研究构建的小型开发数据集。

sents.en: We select programming tasks from the Java portion of MBXP ( Athiwaratkun et al., 2023 ) and use gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 to generate candidate Java solutions.
sents.zh: 我们从 MBXP（Athiwaratkun 等人，2023）的 Java 部分中选择编程任务，并使用 gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 生成候选的 Java 解决方案。

sents.en: The solutions are generated under two prompting conditions intended to produce contrasting readability characteristics while preserving functional correctness.
sents.zh: 这些解决方案是在两种提示条件下生成的，旨在在保持功能正确性的同时产生对比鲜明的可读性特征。

paragraphs.en: The high-readability condition asks the model to act as a proficient Java developer and produce a clear implementation:
paragraphs.zh: 高可读性条件要求模型扮演一名熟练的 Java 开发者的角色，并生成清晰的实现代码：

paragraphs.en: The low-readability condition asks the model to produce a correct but deliberately difficult-to-read implementation. The prompt identifies confusing control flow, ambiguous identifiers, and inappropriate comments as representative sources of low readability:
paragraphs.zh: 低可读性条件要求模型生成一个正确但故意难以阅读的实现。 该提示将混淆的控制流、模糊的标识符和不恰当的注释视为低可读性的典型来源：

sents.en: The low-readability condition asks the model to produce a correct but deliberately difficult-to-read implementation.
sents.zh: 低可读性条件要求模型生成一个正确但故意难以阅读的实现。

sents.en: The prompt identifies confusing control flow, ambiguous identifiers, and inappropriate comments as representative sources of low readability:

paragraphs.en: Each generated program is checked using the task-specific validation procedure provided by MBJP. Programs that fail validation are discarded rather than repaired or assigned a readability score. After this filtering step, the final development dataset contains 17 functionally correct Java solutions: ten generated under the high-readability condition and seven under the low-readability condition.
paragraphs.zh: 每个生成的程序都使用 MBJP 提供的特定任务验证程序进行检查。 未通过验证的程序会被丢弃，而不是进行修复或分配可读性分数。 经过这一筛选步骤后，最终的开发数据集包含 17 个功能正确的 Java 解决方案：其中 10 个是在高可读性条件下生成的，7 个是在低可读性条件下生成的。

sents.en: Each generated program is checked using the task-specific validation procedure provided by MBJP.
sents.zh: 每个生成的程序都使用 MBJP 提供的特定任务验证程序进行检查。

sents.en: After this filtering step, the final development dataset contains 17 functionally correct Java solutions: ten generated under the high-readability condition and seven under the low-readability condition.

paragraphs.en: The prompting condition is used only to introduce variation in the generated code and is not treated as the readability ground truth. Instead, each retained solution is independently evaluated by two human annotators on a five-point readability scale. The mean of the two ratings is used as the continuous target. The annotators achieve a Spearman correlation of 0.829 0.829 and an ICC(2,k) of 0.899 0.899 , indicating strong agreement ( Koo and Li, 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 提示条件仅用于在生成的代码中引入变化，并不被视为可读性的基准事实。 相反，每个保留的解决方案都由两名人类标注者根据五分制的可读性量表进行独立评估。 两项评分的平均值被用作连续目标变量。 标注者的斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.829 0.829，ICC(2,k) 为 0.899 0.899，表明高度一致（Koo and Li, 2016）。

paragraphs.en: We compare BTTF against three conventional readability baselines (LLOC, Posnett, and Scalabrino), two reconstructed learned baselines (Dorn and Mi), and three direct LLM-based baselines. Fixed published models are evaluated using their released implementations or coefficients, whereas the reconstructed baselines are trained according to the protocols described below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 BTTF 与三种传统的可读性基线模型（LLOC、Posnett 和 Scalabrino）、两种重构的学习型基线模型（Dorn 和 Mi）以及三种直接基于 LLM 的基线模型进行比较。 已发布的固定模型使用其公开的实现或系数进行评估，而重构的基线模型则按照下文描述的协议进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Because no pretrained Dorn model was released, we reconstruct the model of Dorn and Weimer ( Dorn, 2012 ) using the public Dorn feature data and the released implementations of its visual metrics. Metrics defined for fewer than 80% of the training samples are excluded, seven features are selected through a forward wrapper evaluated with stratified 10-fold accuracy, and a logistic-regression model is fitted on all 360 Dorn samples. The readable-class probability is used as the continuous readability score.
paragraphs.zh: 由于没有发布预训练的 Dorn 模型，我们利用公开的 Dorn 特征数据及其视觉指标的实现，重建了 Dorn 和 Weimer（Dorn, 2012）的模型。 对于少于 80% 训练样本定义的指标被排除在外，通过分层 10 折准确率评估的前向包装器选择了七个特征，并在全部 360 个 Dorn 样本上拟合了一个逻辑回归模型。 可读类概率被用作连续的可读性得分。

sents.en: Because no pretrained Dorn model was released, we reconstruct the model of Dorn and Weimer ( Dorn, 2012 ) using the public Dorn feature data and the released implementations of its visual metrics.

paragraphs.en: We also reconstruct the character-level ConvNetCR branch described by Mi et al. ( Mi et al., 2018 ) . This reproduction follows the published convolutional architecture but is not presented as the complete DeepCRM model, whose full implementation and trained weights were not released. The model contains three line-spanning convolution banks with 100 feature maps per bank, followed by ReLU activation, global max pooling, dropout, and a two-class output layer. It is trained on the highest and lowest readability quartiles of Buse, the Java subset of Dorn, and Scalabrino, with the middle half of each score distribution excluded. The resulting readable-class probability is used as its continuous score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还重建了 Mi 等人（Mi et al., 2018）所描述的字符级 ConvNetCR 分支。 这一复现遵循已发表的卷积架构，但并未作为完整的 DeepCRM 模型呈现，因为该模型的完整实现和训练权重并未公开。 该模型包含三个跨越整行文本的卷积银行，每个银行有 100 个特征图，随后接有 ReLU 激活函数、全局最大池化、dropout 和一个二分类输出层。 它在 Buse、Dorn 的 Java 子集以及 Scalabrino 中可读性最高和最低的 quartile 上进行训练，同时排除了每个分数分布的中间一半数据。 最终得到的可读类概率值被用作其连续分数。

sents.en: We also reconstruct the character-level ConvNetCR branch described by Mi et al. ( Mi et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: 我们还重建了 Mi 等人（Mi et al., 2018）所描述的字符级 ConvNetCR 分支。

sents.en: This reproduction follows the published convolutional architecture but is not presented as the complete DeepCRM model, whose full implementation and trained weights were not released.

sents.en: It is trained on the highest and lowest readability quartiles of Buse, the Java subset of Dorn, and Scalabrino, with the middle half of each score distribution excluded.
sents.zh: 它在 Buse、Dorn 的 Java 子集以及 Scalabrino 中可读性最高和最低的 quartile 上进行训练，同时排除了每个分数分布的中间一半数据。

sents.en: The resulting readable-class probability is used as its continuous score.
sents.zh: 最终得到的可读类概率值被用作其连续分数。

paragraphs.en: Ouédraogo et al. ( Ouédraogo et al., 2025 ) systematically compare zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and tree-of-thought prompting for code readability assessment. In their study, zero-shot prompting obtains the lowest mean absolute error with respect to human readability scores. We therefore adopt their developer-guided zero-shot formulation as our direct LLM baseline and instantiate it with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Sol. The main paper reports DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 and GPT-6.1 Sol; the complete GPT-6 Sol results are retained in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: Ouédraogo 等人 (Ouédraogo 等人，2025) 系统性地比较了零样本、少样本、思维链和思维树提示方法在代码可读性评估中的表现。 在他们的研究中，零样本提示方法在人类可读性评分方面获得了最低的均方根误差。 因此，我们采用他们提出的由开发者引导的零样本公式作为直接的 LLM 基线模型，并使用 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813、GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 进行具体实现。 主论文报告了 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的结果；完整的 GPT-6 Sol 结果保留在补充材料中。

sents.en: We therefore adopt their developer-guided zero-shot formulation as our direct LLM baseline and instantiate it with DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, GPT-6 Sol, and GPT-6.1 Sol.

paragraphs.en: The same prompt is applied to every sample without demonstrations or access to the corresponding human readability labels. Each model scores every sample three times, and we report the mean. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol are evaluated through the OpenAI API using the model identifiers gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-sol . GPT-6 uses no additional reasoning effort, while GPT-6.1 uses low reasoning effort, the minimum level supported by that model. None of the models receives tools or executes an agentic workflow; each source unit is judged independently from the fixed prompt. The experiments were run on October 2–3, 2026, and the returned model identifiers, scores, explanations, token usage, and request parameters are retained with the per-sample results.
paragraphs.zh: 每个样本都应用相同的提示，且不提供示范或访问对应的人类可读性标签。 每个模型对每个样本进行三次评分，我们报告其平均值。 GPT-6 Sol 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 通过 OpenAI API 进行评估，使用的模型标识符分别为 gpt-6-sol 和 gpt-6.1-sol。 GPT-6 不使用额外的推理努力，而 GPT-6.1 使用低推理努力，即该模型支持的最小级别。 所有模型均未接收工具或执行智能体工作流程；每个源单元均基于固定提示独立判断。 实验于 2026 年 10 月 2 日至 3 日运行，返回的模型标识符、评分、解释、令牌使用量和请求参数均与每个样本的结果一同保留。

paragraphs.en: The code is generally clean and readable, with a logical structure and clear intent. It performs three distinct actions: selecting a row, retrieving a program object, and creating a context menu. Each action is on its own line, which supports good action granularity. Nesting is flat, and the flow is natural. However, the readability is slightly reduced by the long method call to create a context menu, which could be more concise or broken down. Additionally, the use of getValueAt(row, 1) assumes knowledge of the table model’s column indices, which could be made clearer with a named constant. Overall, the code is straightforward but could benefit from minor refactoring for improved clarity.
paragraphs.zh: 这段代码总体上干净易读，结构合乎逻辑，意图明确。 它执行三个独立的操作：选择一行、获取程序对象以及创建上下文菜单。 每个操作都单独占一行，这有助于实现良好的操作颗粒度。 嵌套层次较浅，流程自然流畅。 然而，创建上下文菜单时较长的方法调用略微降低了可读性，这部分代码可以写得更简洁或拆分成更小的部分。 此外，使用 getValueAt(row, 1) 假设了开发者了解表格模型的列索引，若用命名常量替代，代码会更为清晰。 总体而言，这段代码逻辑清晰，但通过少量重构可进一步提升可读性。

paragraphs.en: The three statements follow a logical sequence: select a row, retrieve its Program, then create a context menu. Nesting is absent, each line performs one action, and the code is concise. Intent and reading flow are clear, though the long chained call and numeric column index slightly reduce readability.

paragraphs.en: Code Structure: Three logically ordered statements, clearly separated. Nesting: Completely flat, with no nested control flow. Clarity of intent: Selecting a row, retrieving its Program, and creating a context menu are apparent, though the variable name p, numeric column indices, and boolean arguments lack descriptive context. Code length: Concise, with no unnecessary statements. Action granularity: Each line performs one main action, although the final statement chains several calls. Reading flow: Natural progression from selection to data retrieval to menu creation; the long final line slightly reduces readability.
paragraphs.zh: 代码结构：三个逻辑顺序清晰的语句，彼此明确分开。 嵌套结构：完全扁平，没有任何嵌套的控制流。 意图清晰度：选择一行、获取其程序以及创建上下文菜单的意图显而易见，但变量名 p、数值列索引和布尔参数缺乏描述性上下文。 代码长度：简洁，没有冗余的语句。 操作粒度：每行执行一个主要操作，尽管最后一行串联了多个调用。 阅读流畅度：从选择到数据获取再到菜单创建的流程自然顺畅；但最后一行的过长略微降低了可读性。

paragraphs.en: We construct two controlled readability-interference datasets, one for Java and one for Python. Each dataset contains 100 production-code classes selected evenly from four open-source projects. The Java dataset contains 25 classes from Apache Kafka, Google Guava, Netty, and Spring Framework. The Python dataset contains 25 classes from Django, Flask, Requests, and attrs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了两个受控的可读性干扰数据集，一个用于 Java，另一个用于 Python。 每个数据集都包含 100 个生产代码类，这些类从四个开源项目中均匀选取。 Java 数据集包含来自 Apache Kafka、Google Guava、Netty 和 Spring Framework 的 25 个类。 Python 数据集包含来自 Django、Flask、Requests 和 attrs 的 25 个类。

sents.en: We construct two controlled readability-interference datasets, one for Java and one for Python.
sents.zh: 我们构建了两个受控的可读性干扰数据集，一个用于 Java，另一个用于 Python。

sents.en: Each dataset contains 100 production-code classes selected evenly from four open-source projects.
sents.zh: 每个数据集都包含 100 个生产代码类，这些类从四个开源项目中均匀选取。

sents.en: The Java dataset contains 25 classes from Apache Kafka, Google Guava, Netty, and Spring Framework.
sents.zh: Java 数据集包含来自 Apache Kafka、Google Guava、Netty 和 Spring Framework 的 25 个类。

sents.en: The Python dataset contains 25 classes from Django, Flask, Requests, and attrs.
sents.zh: Python 数据集包含来自 Django、Flask、Requests 和 attrs 的 25 个类。

paragraphs.en: For every source class, we independently apply 13 readability interferences. Each transformed variant is generated directly from the original source rather than from a previously transformed version. Consequently, the datasets do not define cumulative degradation levels, and the response to each interference can be evaluated against the same original source.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个源类，我们都会独立地应用 13 种可读性干扰。 每个转换后的变体都是直接从原始源生成的，而不是从先前转换过的版本生成的。 因此，这些数据集并未定义累积的降级程度，并且每次干扰的反应都可以基于相同的原始源进行评估。

sents.en: For every source class, we independently apply 13 readability interferences.
sents.zh: 对于每个源类，我们都会独立地应用 13 种可读性干扰。

sents.en: Each transformed variant is generated directly from the original source rather than from a previously transformed version.
sents.zh: 每个转换后的变体都是直接从原始源生成的，而不是从先前转换过的版本生成的。

sents.en: Consequently, the datasets do not define cumulative degradation levels, and the response to each interference can be evaluated against the same original source.
sents.zh: 因此，这些数据集并未定义累积的降级程度，并且每次干扰的反应都可以基于相同的原始源进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Each language-specific dataset contains 100 original classes and 100 × 13 = 1,300 100\times 13=1{,}300 interference variants, resulting in 1,400 records per language and 2,800 records in total. Some transformations are not applicable to every class. For example, integer-literal encoding cannot change a class containing no eligible decimal integer literal. Such unchanged variants remain in the dataset for completeness. The evaluation includes only source pairs that differ, yielding 896 changed Java variants and 920 changed Python variants.
paragraphs.zh: 每个语言特定的数据集都包含 100 个原始类和 100 × 13 = 1,300 个干扰变体，因此每种语言有 1,400 条记录，总共 2,800 条记录。 某些转换并非适用于每个类。 例如，整数字面量编码无法改变一个不包含任何符合条件的十进制整数字面量的类。 为了保持完整性，这些未发生变化的变体仍保留在数据集中。 评估仅包含存在差异的源语言对，由此得到 896 个已更改的 Java 变体和 920 个已更改的 Python 变体。

sents.en: Each language-specific dataset contains 100 original classes and 100 × 13 = 1,300 100\times 13=1{,}300 interference variants, resulting in 1,400 records per language and 2,800 records in total.
sents.zh: 每个语言特定的数据集都包含 100 个原始类和 100 × 13 = 1,300 个干扰变体，因此每种语言有 1,400 条记录，总共 2,800 条记录。

sents.en: Some transformations are not applicable to every class.
sents.zh: 某些转换并非适用于每个类。

sents.en: For example, integer-literal encoding cannot change a class containing no eligible decimal integer literal.
sents.zh: 例如，整数字面量编码无法改变一个不包含任何符合条件的十进制整数字面量的类。

sents.en: Such unchanged variants remain in the dataset for completeness.
sents.zh: 为了保持完整性，这些未发生变化的变体仍保留在数据集中。

sents.en: The evaluation includes only source pairs that differ, yielding 896 changed Java variants and 920 changed Python variants.
sents.zh: 评估仅包含存在差异的源语言对，由此得到 896 个已更改的 Java 变体和 920 个已更改的 Python 变体。

paragraphs.en: The 13 interferences cover seven readability dimensions: comments, identifiers, expressions, code injection, layout, data flow, and control flow. The transformations and the number of source classes for which each produced a source-level change are summarised in Table 15 .
paragraphs.zh: 这 13 种干扰涵盖了七个可读性维度：注释、标识符、表达式、代码注入、布局、数据流和控制流。 各种转换以及每种转换所针对的、在源代码层面产生变化的源类数量，已在表 15 中进行了总结。

sents.en: The 13 interferences cover seven readability dimensions: comments, identifiers, expressions, code injection, layout, data flow, and control flow.
sents.zh: 这 13 种干扰涵盖了七个可读性维度：注释、标识符、表达式、代码注入、布局、数据流和控制流。

sents.en: The transformations and the number of source classes for which each produced a source-level change are summarised in Table 15 .
sents.zh: 各种转换以及每种转换所针对的、在源代码层面产生变化的源类数量，已在表 15 中进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: The two unrelated-code injection conditions use separate sets of ten templates. Readable templates use conventional control flow, formatting, and descriptive identifiers, whereas low-readability templates use compact identifiers, opaque expressions, and deliberately less transparent control flow. Both transformations insert at most one template into a class, allowing their effects to be evaluated under comparable target cardinality.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个无关的代码注入条件各自使用独立的十套模板。 可读性高的模板采用常规的控制流、格式化和描述性标识符，而可读性低的模板则使用紧凑的标识符、不透明的表达式以及刻意设计为不够透明的控制流。 这两种转换方式最多都会在类中插入一个模板，从而使其效果能够在具有可比性的目标基数条件下进行评估。

sents.en: The two unrelated-code injection conditions use separate sets of ten templates.
sents.zh: 这两个无关的代码注入条件各自使用独立的十套模板。

sents.en: Readable templates use conventional control flow, formatting, and descriptive identifiers, whereas low-readability templates use compact identifiers, opaque expressions, and deliberately less transparent control flow.
sents.zh: 可读性高的模板采用常规的控制流、格式化和描述性标识符，而可读性低的模板则使用紧凑的标识符、不透明的表达式以及刻意设计为不够透明的控制流。

sents.en: Both transformations insert at most one template into a class, allowing their effects to be evaluated under comparable target cardinality.
sents.zh: 这两种转换方式最多都会在类中插入一个模板，从而使其效果能够在具有可比性的目标基数条件下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Identifier transformations operate on eligible method, parameter, and local-variable bindings and update recognised references consistently. Constructors and language-required names are preserved. Candidate names that would conflict with existing bindings or language keywords are rejected. Misleading identifiers are selected primarily by length proximity to the original name, while garbled identifiers follow a deterministic shortest-available-name strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 标识符转换作用于符合条件的函数、参数和局部变量绑定，并一致地更新已识别的引用。 构造函数和语言要求的名称会被保留。 可能与现有绑定或语言关键字冲突的候选名称将被拒绝。 具有误导性的标识符主要根据与原始名称的长度接近程度进行选择，而乱码标识符则遵循一种确定性的最短可用名称策略。

sents.en: Identifier transformations operate on eligible method, parameter, and local-variable bindings and update recognised references consistently.
sents.zh: 标识符转换作用于符合条件的函数、参数和局部变量绑定，并一致地更新已识别的引用。

sents.en: Constructors and language-required names are preserved.
sents.zh: 构造函数和语言要求的名称会被保留。

sents.en: Candidate names that would conflict with existing bindings or language keywords are rejected.
sents.zh: 可能与现有绑定或语言关键字冲突的候选名称将被拒绝。

sents.en: Misleading identifiers are selected primarily by length proximity to the original name, while garbled identifiers follow a deterministic shortest-available-name strategy.
sents.zh: 具有误导性的标识符主要根据与原始名称的长度接近程度进行选择，而乱码标识符则遵循一种确定性的最短可用名称策略。

paragraphs.en: Integer-literal encoding rewrites eligible decimal integer literals using lowercase hexadecimal notation. It does not recursively transform literals that are already hexadecimal. Numeric-intermediate introduction performs the complementary data-flow modification: an eligible integer literal is decomposed into two values stored in newly introduced short-named variables, and the original literal is replaced by their sum.
paragraphs.zh: 整数字面量编码会采用小写十六进制表示法来重写符合条件的十进制整数字面量。 它不会递归转换已经为十六进制的字面量。 数值中间变量的引入则执行互补的数据流修改：一个符合条件的整数字面量会被分解为两个值，存储在新引入的短命名变量中，而原始字面量则被它们的和所取代。

sents.en: Integer-literal encoding rewrites eligible decimal integer literals using lowercase hexadecimal notation.
sents.zh: 整数字面量编码会采用小写十六进制表示法来重写符合条件的十进制整数字面量。

sents.en: It does not recursively transform literals that are already hexadecimal.
sents.zh: 它不会递归转换已经为十六进制的字面量。

sents.en: Numeric-intermediate introduction performs the complementary data-flow modification: an eligible integer literal is decomposed into two values stored in newly introduced short-named variables, and the original literal is replaced by their sum.
sents.zh: 数值中间变量的引入则执行互补的数据流修改：一个符合条件的整数字面量会被分解为两个值，存储在新引入的短命名变量中，而原始字面量则被它们的和所取代。

paragraphs.en: Intermediate-variable inlining targets eligible local variables that have an initializer, are not subsequently reassigned, and have exactly one supported use. The declaration is removed, and the use is replaced by a parenthesised copy of the initializer. Language-specific exclusions are applied where the transformation cannot be performed reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 中间变量内联操作针对符合条件的局部变量，这些变量具有初始化器、之后未被重新赋值，且恰好有一个被支持的使用。 该声明将被移除，而使用处则被初始化的括弧复制形式所替代。 在无法可靠执行该转换的情况下，将应用语言特定的排除规则。

sents.en: Intermediate-variable inlining targets eligible local variables that have an initializer, are not subsequently reassigned, and have exactly one supported use.
sents.zh: 中间变量内联操作针对符合条件的局部变量，这些变量具有初始化器、之后未被重新赋值，且恰好有一个被支持的使用。

sents.en: The declaration is removed, and the use is replaced by a parenthesised copy of the initializer.
sents.zh: 该声明将被移除，而使用处则被初始化的括弧复制形式所替代。

sents.en: Language-specific exclusions are applied where the transformation cannot be performed reliably.
sents.zh: 在无法可靠执行该转换的情况下，将应用语言特定的排除规则。

paragraphs.en: Condition, data-flow, and control-flow transformations are applied only when the corresponding syntactic structures satisfy their safety constraints. Java loop lowering covers eligible classic and enhanced for loops. Python loop lowering covers eligible synchronous for loops using explicit iterator-based control flow. Therefore, the number of changed variants differs across transformations and languages.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当相应的句法结构满足其安全约束时，才会应用条件、数据流和控制流的转换。 Java 循环降级涵盖符合条件的经典 for 循环和增强 for 循环。 Python 循环降级涵盖使用显式迭代器控制流的符合条件的同步 for 循环。 因此，不同转换和语言中变更的变体数量存在差异。

sents.en: Condition, data-flow, and control-flow transformations are applied only when the corresponding syntactic structures satisfy their safety constraints.
sents.zh: 仅当相应的句法结构满足其安全约束时，才会应用条件、数据流和控制流的转换。

sents.en: Java loop lowering covers eligible classic and enhanced for loops.
sents.zh: Java 循环降级涵盖符合条件的经典 for 循环和增强 for 循环。

sents.en: Python loop lowering covers eligible synchronous for loops using explicit iterator-based control flow.
sents.zh: Python 循环降级涵盖使用显式迭代器控制流的符合条件的同步 for 循环。

sents.en: Therefore, the number of changed variants differs across transformations and languages.
sents.zh: 因此，不同转换和语言中变更的变体数量存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Both datasets are generated deterministically using the fixed seed 20260823 . Every original and generated Java source is decoded as UTF-8 and parsed with Tree-sitter Java without syntax errors. Every original and generated Python source is valid UTF-8 and must parse successfully using the standard-library ast.parse implementation. A validation failure terminates dataset construction rather than retaining an invalid variant.
paragraphs.zh: 两个数据集均使用固定种子 20260823 以确定性方式生成。 所有原始和生成的 Java 源代码均以 UTF-8 解码，并通过 Tree-sitter Java 解析，且无语法错误。 所有原始和生成的 Python 源代码均为有效的 UTF-8，并且必须能通过标准库中的 ast.parse 实现成功解析。 一旦验证失败，数据集构建过程将终止，而非保留无效的变体。

sents.en: Both datasets are generated deterministically using the fixed seed 20260823 .
sents.zh: 两个数据集均使用固定种子 20260823 以确定性方式生成。

sents.en: Every original and generated Java source is decoded as UTF-8 and parsed with Tree-sitter Java without syntax errors.
sents.zh: 所有原始和生成的 Java 源代码均以 UTF-8 解码，并通过 Tree-sitter Java 解析，且无语法错误。

sents.en: Every original and generated Python source is valid UTF-8 and must parse successfully using the standard-library ast.parse implementation.
sents.zh: 所有原始和生成的 Python 源代码均为有效的 UTF-8，并且必须能通过标准库中的 ast.parse 实现成功解析。

sents.en: A validation failure terminates dataset construction rather than retaining an invalid variant.
sents.zh: 一旦验证失败，数据集构建过程将终止，而非保留无效的变体。

paragraphs.en: For each record, we store its source project and path, base-sample identifier, variant identifier, parent identifier, interference category, interference name, transformation statistics, line count, original content hash, and transformed content hash. Repository revisions are recorded where available. The hashes identify unchanged variants without requiring manual source comparison and support verification of deterministic regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条记录，我们都会存储其来源项目与路径、基础样本标识符、变体标识符、父级标识符、干扰类别、干扰名称、转换统计信息、行数、原始内容哈希以及转换后内容的哈希。 在可用的情况下，我们会记录仓库的修订版本。 这些哈希值能够识别未发生变化的变体，无需手动比较源代码，并支持对确定性再生过程的验证。

sents.en: For each record, we store its source project and path, base-sample identifier, variant identifier, parent identifier, interference category, interference name, transformation statistics, line count, original content hash, and transformed content hash.
sents.zh: 对于每条记录，我们都会存储其来源项目与路径、基础样本标识符、变体标识符、父级标识符、干扰类别、干扰名称、转换统计信息、行数、原始内容哈希以及转换后内容的哈希。

sents.en: Repository revisions are recorded where available.
sents.zh: 在可用的情况下，我们会记录仓库的修订版本。

sents.en: The hashes identify unchanged variants without requiring manual source comparison and support verification of deterministic regeneration.
sents.zh: 这些哈希值能够识别未发生变化的变体，无需手动比较源代码，并支持对确定性再生过程的验证。

paragraphs.en: The transformations operate locally on complete source classes. Binding-aware identifier updates, collision checks for introduced names, and structure-specific rewrite rules preserve source consistency, while parsing ensures class-level syntactic validity.
paragraphs.zh: 这些转换在完整的源类上局部执行。 绑定感知的标识符更新、为新引入名称进行的冲突检查以及结构特定的重写规则可保持源的一致性，而解析则确保类级别的语法有效性。

sents.en: The transformations operate locally on complete source classes.
sents.zh: 这些转换在完整的源类上局部执行。

sents.en: Binding-aware identifier updates, collision checks for introduced names, and structure-specific rewrite rules preserve source consistency, while parsing ensures class-level syntactic validity.
sents.zh: 绑定感知的标识符更新、为新引入名称进行的冲突检查以及结构特定的重写规则可保持源的一致性，而解析则确保类级别的语法有效性。

paragraphs.en: Response rates for all 13 individual interference types in Java and Python are reported in Tables 16 and 17 .
paragraphs.zh: Java 和 Python 中所有 13 种单独干扰类型的响应率均报告于表 16 和表 17 中。

paragraphs.en: Scalabrino produced finite predictions for 97 of the 100 Java groups, while all other methods processed all 100 groups. Percentages are calculated over each method’s available changed pairs.
paragraphs.zh: Scalabrino 对 100 个 Java 组中的 97 个组生成了有限预测，而其他所有方法都处理了全部 100 个组。 百分比是根据每种方法可用的已更改配对计算得出的。

sents.en: Scalabrino produced finite predictions for 97 of the 100 Java groups, while all other methods processed all 100 groups.
sents.zh: Scalabrino 对 100 个 Java 组中的 97 个组生成了有限预测，而其他所有方法都处理了全部 100 个组。

sents.en: Percentages are calculated over each method’s available changed pairs.
sents.zh: 百分比是根据每种方法可用的已更改配对计算得出的。

paragraphs.en: Before adding causal-LM predictability candidates, the same screening procedure was applied to the 181 eligible traditional and embedding-derived candidates. The resulting independently selected model contains ten traditional and eight embedding-derived features. Its selection procedure is reported in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 在添加因果-LM可预测性候选特征之前，对181个符合条件的传统特征和嵌入衍生特征应用了相同的筛选流程。 最终独立选出的模型包含十个传统特征和八个嵌入衍生特征。 其选择流程见附录B。

sents.en: Before adding causal-LM predictability candidates, the same screening procedure was applied to the 181 eligible traditional and embedding-derived candidates.
sents.zh: 在添加因果-LM可预测性候选特征之前，对181个符合条件的传统特征和嵌入衍生特征应用了相同的筛选流程。

sents.en: The resulting independently selected model contains ten traditional and eight embedding-derived features.
sents.zh: 最终独立选出的模型包含十个传统特征和八个嵌入衍生特征。

sents.en: Its selection procedure is reported in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 其选择流程见附录B。

paragraphs.en: The retained measurements are operator density, source-text entropy, expression–literal density, longest line length, computation-and-control pattern count, identifier embedding dispersion, mean indentation change, structural-pattern mixing under OPTICS and agglomerative clustering, structural embedding dispersion, regular-expression prevalence, short-identifier prevalence, short-identifier mathematical context, bitwise-operation prevalence, unclustered structural-snippet ratio, identifier-length variation, decision density, and operator-character share.
paragraphs.zh: 保留的测量指标包括：算子密度、源文本熵、表达式–字面量密度、最长行长度、计算与控制模式数量、标识符嵌入离散度、平均缩进变化、OPTICS 和凝聚聚类下的结构模式混合度、结构嵌入离散度、正则表达式普遍性、短标识符普遍性、短标识符的数学上下文、位运算普遍性、未聚类的结构片段比率、标识符长度变化、决策密度以及算子字符占比。

paragraphs.en: Performance of the embedding-only model under each of the five embedding representations used during feature selection is reported in Table 18 . The same 18 feature definitions, Ridge pipeline, datasets, and folds are used throughout; only the embedding-derived feature values change.
paragraphs.zh: 在特征选择过程中使用的五种嵌入表示中，仅使用嵌入模型的性能报告见表 18。 全文均使用相同的 18 个特征定义、Ridge 流程、数据集和折；唯一变化的是由嵌入生成的特征值。

sents.en: Performance of the embedding-only model under each of the five embedding representations used during feature selection is reported in Table 18 .
sents.zh: 在特征选择过程中使用的五种嵌入表示中，仅使用嵌入模型的性能报告见表 18。

sents.en: The same 18 feature definitions, Ridge pipeline, datasets, and folds are used throughout; only the embedding-derived feature values change.
sents.zh: 全文均使用相同的 18 个特征定义、Ridge 流程、数据集和折；唯一变化的是由嵌入生成的特征值。

paragraphs.en: The pooled averages range from 0.551 to 0.562, and the LODO averages range from 0.538 to 0.561. The embedding-only model therefore exhibits similar aggregate performance across the five independently fitted embedding representations.
paragraphs.zh: 合并后的平均值范围在 0.551 到 0.562 之间，而 LODO 的平均值范围在 0.538 到 0.561 之间。 因此，仅使用嵌入的模型在这五个独立拟合的嵌入表示上表现出相似的总体性能。

sents.en: The pooled averages range from 0.551 to 0.562, and the LODO averages range from 0.538 to 0.561.
sents.zh: 合并后的平均值范围在 0.551 到 0.562 之间，而 LODO 的平均值范围在 0.538 到 0.561 之间。

sents.en: The embedding-only model therefore exhibits similar aggregate performance across the five independently fitted embedding representations.
sents.zh: 因此，仅使用嵌入的模型在这五个独立拟合的嵌入表示上表现出相似的总体性能。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate the fixed final feature schema using every pairing of the three causal code language models and five embedding models used during consensus selection. The 11 canonical feature definitions, Ridge pipeline, six datasets, and fold assignments remain fixed, and each of the 15 combinations is fitted independently.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用共识选择阶段使用的三种因果代码语言模型与五种嵌入模型的所有组合，来实例化固定的最终特征方案。 11 个标准特征定义、Ridge 流程、六个数据集以及折划分分配均保持不变，且 15 种组合各自独立进行拟合。

sents.en: We instantiate the fixed final feature schema using every pairing of the three causal code language models and five embedding models used during consensus selection.
sents.zh: 我们利用共识选择阶段使用的三种因果代码语言模型与五种嵌入模型的所有组合，来实例化固定的最终特征方案。

sents.en: The 11 canonical feature definitions, Ridge pipeline, six datasets, and fold assignments remain fixed, and each of the 15 combinations is fitted independently.
sents.zh: 11 个标准特征定义、Ridge 流程、六个数据集以及折划分分配均保持不变，且 15 种组合各自独立进行拟合。

paragraphs.en: Panel A: Pooled 10-fold cross-validation
paragraphs.zh: 面板A：合并的10折交叉验证

paragraphs.en: Panel B: Leave-one-dataset-out evaluation
paragraphs.zh: 面板B：留一数据集评估

paragraphs.en: Panel C: Java controlled-interference response
paragraphs.zh: 面板 C：Java 受控干扰响应

paragraphs.en: Panel D: Python controlled-interference response
paragraphs.zh: 面板 D：Python 控制干扰响应

paragraphs.en: All 15 independently fitted predictors retain the intended direction for all 11 features.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 15 个独立拟合的预测因子在所有 11 个特征上都保留了预期的方向。

paragraphs.en: We quantify uncertainty in the final OpenCoder and Jina-embedding instantiation using a dataset-stratified nonparametric bootstrap. For each of 10,000 replicates, samples are drawn with replacement within each dataset, Spearman correlation is recomputed for each dataset, and the average gives equal weight to the six datasets. BTTF’s fitted parameters and out-of-fold predictions remain fixed; the intervals therefore quantify sampling uncertainty in the reported predictions rather than variation from retraining or feature selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用数据集分层非参数自助法来量化最终 OpenCoder 和 Jina-embedding 实例化中的不确定性。 在每次 10,000 次重复实验中，每个数据集内都进行有放回抽样，重新计算每个数据集的斯皮尔曼相关系数，并对六个数据集赋予相等的权重以得到平均值。 BTTF 的拟合参数和折叠外预测结果保持固定；因此，这些置信区间量化的是所报告预测中的抽样不确定性，而非因重新训练或特征选择而产生的差异。

sents.en: We quantify uncertainty in the final OpenCoder and Jina-embedding instantiation using a dataset-stratified nonparametric bootstrap.
sents.zh: 我们使用数据集分层非参数自助法来量化最终 OpenCoder 和 Jina-embedding 实例化中的不确定性。

sents.en: For each of 10,000 replicates, samples are drawn with replacement within each dataset, Spearman correlation is recomputed for each dataset, and the average gives equal weight to the six datasets.
sents.zh: 在每次 10,000 次重复实验中，每个数据集内都进行有放回抽样，重新计算每个数据集的斯皮尔曼相关系数，并对六个数据集赋予相等的权重以得到平均值。

sents.en: BTTF’s fitted parameters and out-of-fold predictions remain fixed; the intervals therefore quantify sampling uncertainty in the reported predictions rather than variation from retraining or feature selection.
sents.zh: BTTF 的拟合参数和折叠外预测结果保持固定；因此，这些置信区间量化的是所报告预测中的抽样不确定性，而非因重新训练或特征选择而产生的差异。

paragraphs.en: We additionally compare the fixed BTTF predictions with GPT-6.1 Sol using a paired, dataset-stratified bootstrap. Each replicate draws the same samples for both methods within each dataset and equally averages the six resulting correlation differences.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还通过配对的数据集分层自助法，将固定的 BTTF 预测结果与 GPT-6.1 Sol 的预测结果进行比较。 在每组数据中，每次重复都会为两种方法抽取相同的样本，并对由此得到的六个相关系数差异取等权平均。

sents.en: We additionally compare the fixed BTTF predictions with GPT-6.1 Sol using a paired, dataset-stratified bootstrap.
sents.zh: 我们还通过配对的数据集分层自助法，将固定的 BTTF 预测结果与 GPT-6.1 Sol 的预测结果进行比较。

sents.en: Each replicate draws the same samples for both methods within each dataset and equally averages the six resulting correlation differences.
sents.zh: 在每组数据中，每次重复都会为两种方法抽取相同的样本，并对由此得到的六个相关系数差异取等权平均。
